chapters.title: Chapter 660: The Ice That Shatters Shadows
paragraphs: Broken had trained relentlessly to maximize his efficiency with the spear, conserving both Mana and Stamina. He couldn't afford to go all out, not until he fully understood the extent of
Galactron's power.

The Necromancer, no doubt, would hold nothing back. His goal was clear: stop Broken at all costs, or better yet, kill him. But Broken had no time to waste. The capital was under siege, and a massive battle raged there. He had to make it in time.
With a quick breath, he activated his skill.
[Ocean's Wrath (Active Skill) activated.]
The ground trembled as waves of shimmering water materialized around Broken, crashing forward in a torrent toward Galactron and his skeletal army.

Galactron's eyes gleamed faintly, and with a flicker of movement, he floated backward, effortlessly dodging the oncoming waves. His summons, however, weren't so lucky. The force of the water slammed into them, sending many tumbling backward.
Seizing the opening, Broken dashed forward.
His spear spun in his hands as he delivered a precise sweep, followed by a powerful thrust and a defensive spin parry.
[Spear Guard (Conditional Passive Skill) Lv. 5 triggered.]
One of the skeletons lunged, but Broken's spear caught the attack perfectly, deflecting it and sending the creature sprawling to the ground.
[Groundbreaker (Active Skill) Lv. 5 activated.]
Broken slammed the spear into the earth, creating a shockwave that erupted around him. Several skeletons were flung backward, their bones rattling as they crumbled under the force.
But the skeleton warriors were relentless. They attacked from all directions with brutal precision, completely disregarding the damage they sustained.
Broken countered each strike, his movements fluid and agile. Overhead strikes, sweeping cuts, precision thrusts.
He knew the fastest way to defeat a summoner was to go for the summoner himself. Galactron was the linchpin. If Broken could break through and land a decisive blow, the battle would be over.
But damn it-these skeletons just kept coming. Their numbers weren't just overwhelming; they seemed to multiply.
"Damn it!"
His frustration mounted as more skeletons rose to replace those he had already destroyed.
Broken pulled on his Legendary-grade Flowing Tide Cape, the fabric shimmering like liquid water in the sunlight. With a quick motion, he activated his Water Domain.
A dome of shimmering water expanded outward, enveloping the skeleton warriors surrounding him.
[Sea of Storms (Active Skill) activated.]
Dozens of magic circles appeared in the air above him, glowing faintly before unleashing a barrage of water spears that rained down mercilessly on the skeleton warriors below.
The spears struck with devastating force, shattering many of the skeletons into splinters of bone and shadow.
But the respite was brief. More skeletons emerged from the edges of the battlefield, clawing their way out of Galactron's ever-present magic circles.
What about their damage, do they have good damage output?
Yes they did.

Their attacks weren't particularly strong on their own, but their sheer numbers made it impossible to ignore. Each scratch and strike chipped away at Broken's health, the swarm slowly wearing him down.
[Nature's Herald (Active Skill) Lv. 2 Activated]
Summoning one of his Gaia Beasts, Broken called forth the Elder Tree Dragon.

A dragon formed from twisting wood and lush greenery appeared above the battlefield. It roared as it swooped through the air. With a deep breath, the dragon unleashed a sweeping magic attack, its breath tearing through the skeleton warriors like a storm.
Despite the relief, more skeletons replaced the fallen. The battlefield was becoming a war of attrition, and Broken knew he couldn't keep this up indefinitely.

He continued to fight. His spear spun in elegant arcs, cutting through skeletons with sweeps, thrusts, and powerful underhand strikes. Each movement was precise, but the endless swarm left him little room to breathe.
Seeing no other choice, Broken leapt toward Galactron, aiming to end this at its source. His spear glinted as he launched himself forward, ready to strike.
But Galactron simply smirked.
The Necromancer floated effortlessly away, drifting just out of reach with an infuriating ease.

Broken's spear spun as he slashed through another wave of skeleton warriors, his frustration mounting. He had plenty of area attacks, but the mana usage for those skills was too high to sustain against an enemy that seemed endlessly replenished.

His Invincible Paragon defensive skills were holding up well, mitigating much of the damage from the relentless attacks. But even with his strong defense, it was clear this battle wasn't about defeating him-it was about stalling.
Damn it!
Broken gritted his teeth as the realization hit harder.
Galactron wasn't trying to win outright. This entire fight was a deliberate ploy to waste his time, to drain his resources and leave him weaker for the real battle at the capital.
Then, suddenly-
The temperature around him dropped drastically!
Broken's movements faltered as his breath became visible in the air. "What the...?" he muttered, glancing around in confusion.

In an instant, the ground beneath him began to freeze, shards of ice spreading out in intricate, jagged patterns. The ice expanded rapidly, forming a massive magic circle of fragmented frost across the battlefield.
Before he could react further, the encroaching ice enveloped the skeleton warriors, freezing them in place.
The horde that had been relentlessly attacking moments ago was now nothing but a frozen army, captured mid-strike in jagged blocks of glistening ice.

As if on cue, a sword fell from the sky with blinding speed, embedding itself into the frozen ground. A shockwave of icy energy erupted outward from the impact, sending cascading explosions of frost in all directions.
The frozen skeletons shattered instantly, their remains scattering like brittle glass.
Broken shielded his face from the blast, lowering his arm only when the icy destruction subsided.
Above, a figure descended gracefully, landing atop the hilt of the sword now lodged in the ground.
Balanced perfectly, a man stood tall, his long black hair tied back behind him. He wore light blue armor with an icy sheen.
Broken turned to the newcomer. It was Frostedge, someone he had sparred with a few weeks ago.
The man descended gracefully from his sword, landing lightly on the ground before pulling the blade free. He turned to Broken, holding his sword downward with both hands, and gave a slight bow.
"Broken, forgive my interruption. I happened to be passing by and noticed this swarm of skeleton warriors."
"Btw, thanks for the assistance," Broken replied.
"Anyway," Frostedge continued, "I'm on my way to the capital and was hoping I could hitch a ride in your carriage-if you don't mind."
"Sure, that's fine," Broken said with a small nod. "But I think you'll need to wait until I'm done dealing with these skeletons."
Frostedge nodded again. He glanced toward Galactron, a faint smile playing on his lips.
"Broken," Frostedge said casually, not looking away from Galactron, "would you mind if I... helped speed up your journey a bit?"
"Surely, that would be appreciated," Broken replied, stepping to Frostedge's side. "Any help is always welcome."

Galactron, standing at a distance, remained motionless for a moment. Then, a low chuckle escaped his lips. He lowered his head slightly, running a hand through his messy brown hair before pushing it back.
"Ha ha ha..." Galactron's shoulders shook as his chuckles grew louder. He raised his head, his grin stretching wide.
"I'm so happy!" he exclaimed. "Hahaha! This is going to be so much fun!"
From the guild chat, members who were keeping tabs on the situation quickly chimed in with their comments.
[Goldrich]: "We have three protagonists from different perspectives meeting in the same
place. This feels like a pivotal moment in a novel."
[Tora]: "Damn it! I should be there to witness that battle firsthand!"
[Freya]: "I'm on my way toward Broken's location with RememberMe and the others. Let me
record what's about to become an epic showdown."
[RememberMe]: "Hahaha! This is going to be so much fun to watch!"

"Surely, that would be appreciated," Broken replied, stepping to Frostedge's side.
"Any help is always welcome."
Galactron, standing at a distance, remained motionless for a moment.
Then, a low chuckle escaped his lips.
He lowered his head slightly, running a hand through his messy brown hair before pushing it back.
"Ha ha ha..." Galactron's shoulders shook as his chuckles grew louder.
He raised his head, his grin stretching wide.
"I'm so happy!" he exclaimed.
"Hahaha!
This is going to be so much fun!"
From the guild chat, members who were keeping tabs on the situation quickly chimed in with their comments.

place.
This feels like a pivotal moment in a novel."

I should be there to witness that battle firsthand!"
[Freya]: "I'm on my way toward Broken's location with RememberMe and the others.
Let me
record what's about to become an epic showdown."
[RememberMe]: "Hahaha!
This is going to be so much fun to watch!"

chapters.title: Chapter 661: Galactron's Nightmare Summons
paragraphs: What was Frostedge doing here? He mentioned heading to the capital earlier.
Of course everyone knew something monumental was happening in the capital. A massive war was underway, and someone like Frostedge wouldn't want to miss a rare moment like this.
Fighting any demons there would undoubtedly yield significant experience points, and contributing to the takedown of a Named Demon could mean unparalleled rewards.

For now, the battlefield was clear of skeleton warriors, all of them frozen and shattered by Frostedge's earlier display of power. However, Galactron still stood at a distance, his expression flat and unbothered.
A sudden agreement had been made-Frostedge would assist Broken in defeating Galactron in exchange for a ride to the capital.
Not a bad deal, all things considered.
But Galactron wasn't fazed. His grimoire spun faster now, emanating green-and-black energy.
Broken's eyes narrowed-he recognized this pattern. Galactron was preparing another summon.

Surely, he's not out of summons already. No way he'd run dry against two Divine Champions, right? For an instant, the scene might've looked like two adults bullying a teenage boy. But in this game, appearances were deceiving. Galactron wasn't just a child-he was a Necromancer with overwhelming power. A divine champion, and also a Unique-grade class holder.
Broken and Frostedge both knew that fighting him alone would be a monumental challenge, even if it seemed unfair on the surface.

Suddenly, magic circles began forming around Galactron, their glow intensifying as the energy built. Broken and Frostedge exchanged a glance, their shared intent clear-they needed to stop him before he could summon anything.
They moved as one, both rushing toward Galactron with speed and precision.

But the Necromancer proved himself again to be exceptionally agile. Despite floating mere inches off the ground, he moved with uncanny speed, weaving between their attacks. Frostedge slashed his sword, sending a spike of ice erupting from the ground, racing toward Galactron.
But the boy deftly dodged, his movements fluid and deliberate.
Meanwhile, the five magic circles that floated near him pulsed brighter.
And then, from each circle, a figure emerged.
The summons were different this time-taller, larger, and more imposing than the skeleton warriors from earlier. Each of them was clad in shadow-infused armor.
One carried a massive greatsword.
Another bore a tower shield and a longsword.
A third wielded a bow, shadowy tendrils coiling around its arrows.
The fourth hefted a colossal battle axe.
The fifth carried a magic staff, green flames flickering at its tip as it floated slightly above the ground.
Broken and Frostedge skidded to a stop, their pursuit halted as five elite skeleton summons stepped into their path, forming an impenetrable line between them and Galactron.

The skeletons were no ordinary foes. Each one carried a different weapon and seemed to fill a specific role. Their hollow eyes glowed with a cold light, and their presence was oppressive, like an unspoken challenge.
Broken quickly assessed the situation, his gaze flicking over their forms as he checked their levels. Over 210, on average.
He clenched his jaw. Damn it.
This Galactron wasn't holding back-summoning five high-level elite summons was no small feat. It was clear he intended to make this battle as grueling as possible.
"Galactron... is this all you've got?" Broken called out.
Galactron smirked. "Well, hah! Why would I reveal my strategy to the likes of you?"
The air grew heavier as the skeletons advanced.
Broken muttered under his breath. "Well, he's definitely confident in his strategy. But seriously, these five are going to be a problem."
"Broken, how do we split these guys up?" Frostedge asked.
Broken shrugged. "I don't mind if you take three of them."
Frostedge chuckled, shaking his head. "Ah, no thanks. I'm not that eager to die."
"Which ones do you handle best?"
"The archer and the mage," Frostedge replied. "But..." he added, "the other three look tough to pin down."
Broken nodded. "This fight's going to be hell if the mage and archer aren't dealt with first. They'll pick us apart if they're left alone."
"I agree," Frostedge replied.
"I'll hold the other three-keep them busy-while you take out the two long-range ones."
"Sounds like a solid plan," Frostedge said with a faint smirk.
Broken's gaze shifted to Galactron, who stood behind his summons.
"If possible, kill the summoner too."
Frostedge gave a small bow, before raising his sword. "Understood."
Both fighters prepared themselves, the tension in the air heavy as they got ready to engage.

Frostedge's body suddenly glowed with a mix of white and icy blue energy. With a graceful motion, a layer of ice formed beneath his feet, propelling him forward as though he were skating across the desert floor.

The Elite Skeletons turned their attention toward him, but Frostedge raised his sword high into the air. The blade shimmered as sharp spikes of ice materialized around him, shooting forward with incredible speed.
The frozen projectiles hurtled toward the two long-range attackers-the skeleton archer and mage standing at the back of the formation.
Meanwhile, Broken readied himself, gripping his spear tightly as he prepared to take on the remaining three skeleton warriors.
From the distance, a carriage appeared, its wheels kicking up dust as it approached the battlefield. The carriage came to a stop, and four figures leapt out-Freya, RememberMe, PussyCat, and Forev.

Forev immediately summoned her spirit hawk, sending it soaring into the sky. Its glowing form hovered high above, capturing the scene below. With its help, Forev began recording the battle, streaming the action directly to the Vensalor Guild Official Channel.
"Hahaha, I'm betting this fight will rake in views to rival the battle at the capital,"
RememberMe said.

Freya smirked. "Frostedge has a massive fanbase, especially among players from his country. And as for Galactron... sure, he has the whole villain vibe, but you can't deny the kid's brilliance. He's earned respect even from his enemies."
"What about Broken?" PussyCat asked with a giggle.

Forev responded. "Broken's popularity has been skyrocketing lately. But many people still can't wrap their heads around it. They're too shocked to believe someone as 'ordinary' as him could rise to the top like this."
"Hah!" RememberMe snorted. "Let reality smack them in the face!"
A few moments later, RememberMe spoke up. "Do you think there's anything else we can do to help them, besides, you know... recording them from a distance?"
Forev sighed. "Yes, you can shut up so my ears don't hurt listening to you."
"Hahaha!" RememberMe burst out laughing.
As soon as the live video of the battle hit the Vensalor Guild Official Channel, the view count skyrocketed. Comments flooded in almost instantly.

Olympics!"

chapters.title: Chapter 662: Elemental Rune Cataclysm
paragraphs: Frostedge glided across the desert, a thin sheet of ice forming beneath his feet as he skated with effortless grace. And this guy-seriously-this guy was skating like an Olympic athlete, weaving and maneuvering with unbelievable agility.
He closed in quickly on his two targets: the archer skeleton and the mage skeleton. The moment they noticed him, both locked onto him with precision.

The mage skeleton unleashed a volley of magic missiles, while the archer skeleton moved with unnerving speed. Despite being nothing more than a collection of bones held together by a mass of shadow and green energy, the skeleton moved with the grace and agility of a living being!

Frostedge swung his sword repeatedly, conjuring discs of ice in midair with rapid precision. The icy shields blocked each projectile as he advanced, his movements fluid and calculated. This magic sword fighter wasn't just fast-he was blindingly fast. He closed the distance to the mage skeleton in moments, his blade flashing as he executed a powerful slash. A massive ice formation erupted around the mage skeleton, rising like jagged spires to entrap it in a frozen prison.
But the mage skeleton didn't go down without resistance. It radiated a violent burst of energy, cracking the ice that encased it, refusing to be subdued.

Meanwhile, the archer skeleton charged its bow with a glowing green arrow. The pull was so intense that the skeleton itself recoiled from the tension of the string. The arrow fired with a deafening snap, rocketing toward Frostedge.
It was a direct hit-

—until, in an instant, walls of ice sprang up behind Frostedge, forming layers of protective barriers. The projectile struck one of the walls with a loud crack, shattering it but failing to reach its target.
Frostedge didn't even look back to see where the protection had come from. His focus remained locked on the mage skeleton.

With a brilliant glow, his sword began to radiate light and ice energy. He moved with lightning speed, executing a precise, devastating slash. The ice shattered in a blinding explosion, and the mage skeleton's form splintered into pieces, its bones scattering across the battlefield.
But... the pieces of bone surged unnaturally through the air, reforming in mere seconds into a complete skeleton once more.
Damn it!
If a player had been hit with that kind of attack, they would've been dead on the spot. But this was no ordinary enemy.
Everyone watching through the live stream-held their breath.
[Syrestage]: "THOSE SKELETONS MOVE BETTER THAN I DO AFTER LEG DAY!"
[Ryan_Houtz]: "Those ice walls showed up like, 'Don't worry, Frostedge, we got your back...'
[hellfire99903]: "I literally stopped breathing when that arrow was fired. Frostedge is out here giving me a heart attack for free!"
[Kody_Decker]: "The way the ice shattered, the mage reformed, and Frostedge just stood there ready to go again-THIS IS CINEMA."
Gravestone Greatsword.
Broken had made his choice. To face these three towering skeletal warriors, each with immense strength and impenetrable defenses, this weapon was his best option.
This fight wouldn't end quickly-Broken was as durable as they came, but so were his opponents.

One skeleton wielded a massive shield and greatsword, another held a gigantic greatsword, and the last carried a colossal battle axe. The word massive perfectly described them, as they loomed over Broken like giants, making him feel like a mere child in their shadow.
Without hesitation, Broken launched himself at the trio, his movement bold and calculated. Hell! He had faith in his Invincible Paragon armor set and the arsenal of defensive skills he had acquired.
He could withstand their blows-but he had no intention of letting their attacks land without a fight.
Broken charged the Sword Skeleton, his Gravestone Greatsword raised high. When their weapons met, the clash was thunderous, sending sparks and echoes across the battlefield.

The greatsword's conditional passive skill, Durability Drainer, activated, steadily sapping the durability of his opponent's weapon with each clash. While Broken wasn't sure if the skeletons' weapons were bound by the same rules as player-crafted items, there would surely be some penalty to their effectiveness over time.
But there was no time to ponder.

The Axe Skeleton lunged next, its massive weapon sweeping through the air with incredible speed and power. Its movements were brutal and relentless, each strike capable of cleaving through most defenses.
Broken maneuvered deftly, his greatsword meeting the axe head-on as he parried. With each clash, the runes etched into the blade of the Gravestone Greatsword began to glow faintly, steadily charging.
"Damn it!" Broken growled as the force of the axe's blow sent him skidding backward.
Before he could recover, the Sword Skeleton was already closing in from behind. Its glowing blade arced toward him in a deadly swing.

Broken dashed forward, dragging the tip of his greatsword across the ground, creating a trail of dust and sparks as he pivoted toward the Shield Skeleton. With a mighty swing, he aimed directly at its shield.
Clang!

The blow was intercepted, the shield absorbing the brunt of the strike with an almost mocking ease. The Shield Skeleton retaliated instantly, bashing Broken backward with its shield before switching to a sweeping sword strike.
Broken raised his greatsword vertically just in time, executing another parry. The collision was enough to send him hurtling backward again, his boots digging into the ground to stabilize himself.
These summons weren't just tough-they were ridiculously strong. Their attacks were merciless, built for raw Strength and Constitution.
They were tanks in every sense of the word, their build making them highly resistant to physical attacks.
They'd be much easier to deal with if I had skills that ignore defense-or even better, magic damage.
The 12 runes on his Gravestone Greatsword glowed brightly, signaling that they were fully charged. A faint smile crept across his face.
With a burst of speed, Broken activated his Dash, propelling himself away from the three Elite Skeleton Warriors. The distance gave him just enough room to set up for what was coming next.
The skeletal warriors weren't going to let him escape easily.
The Axe Skeleton charged forward, its colossal axe swinging wildly, carving through the air with an audible whoosh. Its bulky frame moved surprisingly fast, each step shaking the ground beneath it.
The Greatsword Skeleton followed close behind, its massive blade resting on its shoulder as it sprinted toward Broken with intimidating power.
The Shield Skeleton wasn't far behind, its shield raised in a defensive position as it barreled forward like an unstoppable force, ready to crush anything in its path.
Broken glanced back, the glow of his greatsword intensifying. The timing was perfect.
It was time.
[Sacrificial Edge (Conditional Active Skill) activated.]
[Sacrifices 5% of the greatsword's durability to increase the next attack's damage by 1000%.]
[Elemental Rune Cataclysm (Conditional Active Skill) activated.]
[Releases the power of up to 12 runes in a massive elemental explosion.
Each activated rune deals 500% base physical damage as elemental damage to all nearby enemies.
Elemental Overload: If 4 or more runes of the same element are activated, deals an additional
500% elemental damage over time.]
Just as the three skeletons closed in, their massive forms bearing down on him, Broken activated his ultimate skill.

The runes on his Gravestone Greatsword flared brilliantly, one by one, before extinguishing in rapid succession. A dark, violent energy-swirling with hues of black and green-erupted from the blade, wrapping around it like a storm unleashed.
In the next instant, waves of energy blasted out from the greatsword, each one surging forward with relentless speed and force.
BBBB-BAM! BBB-BAM BAM!
The cascading explosions came in rapid succession, each impact louder and more violent than the last.

The ground trembled under the sheer power of the attack, the air filled with deafening cracks and booms. The energy waves ripped through the area, consuming everything in their path. From the haze of the chaotic energy, massive forms were thrown clear of the destruction. The Greatsword Skeleton's weapon flew from its grip, spinning wildly through the air before crashing into the ground.
The Axe Skeleton was sent hurtling backward, its colossal weapon flung high, tumbling end over end before embedding itself in the sand far away.
The Shield Skeleton's imposing form staggered, its shield dented and battered.
[Qschmee]: "That attack was so loud, my speakers filed for a restraining order." [Ehren_McClelland]: "Okay, Broken. Massive sword, massive energy, massive explosions...
but did it WORK?!"
[Clayborn_Madison]: "If this doesn't work, I'm deleting my tank build. Just saying."

The Axe Skeleton charged forward, its colossal axe swinging wildly, carving through the air with an audible whoosh.
Its bulky frame moved surprisingly fast, each step shaking the ground beneath it.
The Greatsword Skeleton followed close behind, its massive blade resting on its shoulder as it sprinted toward Broken with intimidating power.
The Shield Skeleton wasn't far behind, its shield raised in a defensive position as it barreled forward like an unstoppable force, ready to crush anything in its path.
Broken glanced back, the glow of his greatsword intensifying.
The timing was perfect.
It was time.
[Sacrificial Edge (Conditional Active Skill) activated.]
[Sacrifices 5% of the greatsword's durability to increase the next attack's damage by 1000%.]
[Elemental Rune Cataclysm (Conditional Active Skill) activated.]
[Releases the power of up to 12 runes in a massive elemental explosion.
Each activated rune deals 500% base physical damage as elemental damage to all nearby enemies.
Elemental Overload: If 4 or more runes of the same element are activated, deals an additional
500% elemental damage over time.]
Just as the three skeletons closed in, their massive forms bearing down on him, Broken activated his ultimate skill.
The runes on his Gravestone Greatsword flared brilliantly, one by one, before extinguishing in rapid succession.
A dark, violent energy-swirling with hues of black and green-erupted from the blade, wrapping around it like a storm unleashed.
In the next instant, waves of energy blasted out from the greatsword, each one surging forward with relentless speed and force.
BBBB-BAM!
BBB-BAM BAM!
The cascading explosions came in rapid succession, each impact louder and more violent than the last.
The ground trembled under the sheer power of the attack, the air filled with deafening cracks and booms.
The energy waves ripped through the area, consuming everything in their path.
From the haze of the chaotic energy, massive forms were thrown clear of the destruction.
The Greatsword Skeleton's weapon flew from its grip, spinning wildly through the air before crashing into the ground.
The Axe Skeleton was sent hurtling backward, its colossal weapon flung high, tumbling end over end before embedding itself in the sand far away.
The Shield Skeleton's imposing form staggered, its shield dented and battered.

Massive sword, massive energy, massive explosions...
but did it WORK?!"
[Clayborn_Madison]: "If this doesn't work, I'm deleting my tank build.
Just saying."

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - The Dance of Frost and Spears
paragraphs: Broken wasted no time, seizing the brief window created by the damage his opponents had sustained. He dashed back swiftly, putting distance between himself and the Elite Skeleton Warriors, already preparing for his next move.
Summoning both the Golden Bow of Artemis and the Wavebreaker Spear, he set the spear on the bowstring and began charging his next skill:
[Sniper's Focus (Active Skill) Lv. 5]
The air grew heavy as energy coalesced around him. His eyes fixed not on the recovering skeletons but on Galactron, who floated in the distance, sitting cross-legged in the air with a casual posture.
The remnants of the earlier explosions had faded. The three Elite Skeleton Warriors were visibly struggling to reassemble themselves.
Broken smirked, gripping his weapon tightly. He needed less than two seconds to charge his next skill, and at this range, there was no way they could reach him in time.
The sky seemed to split open, and from above, a massive duplicate of the Wavebreaker Spear emerged, glowing with a radiant blue aura.
The charging time was complete.
Then came the ocean's roar.

The spear shot forward with incredible speed, a streak of light tearing through the desert sky. Its sheer force churned up a massive plume of sand in its wake, a turbulent storm that marked its devastating path.

From above, the Wavebreaker Spear began its descent, accompanied by a torrent of power. Massive waves cascaded from the heavens, flooding the battlefield in a deluge. Water spears rained down like a storm of piercing projectiles, and amidst it all, a wild boar formed from the ocean itself charged through the air.
Broken's aim was flawless—the spear and its devastating oceanic payload were all directed at Galactron.
But just as the attack was about to land—

The Shield Skeleton suddenly surged forward with unnatural speed, as if receiving a direct boost from nowhere. Raising its shield high, it intercepted the Wavebreaker Spear, taking the full brunt of the attack.
BOOM!
A massive explosion of water erupted on the battlefield, the unleashed force creating a vast oceanic deluge that covered the ground in a powerful surge.
The effect didn't stop there.

The water cascading over the battlefield began to freeze, converting into icy shards that exploded repeatedly across the area. Water spears struck the ground and transformed into ice spears, creating chain reactions of icy detonations.

Thanks to Frostedge's being on the same side as Broken, the damage didn't harm him—in fact, his natural affinity amplified the freezing effects, making the battlefield an even deadlier trap for their enemies.
The devastation forced the Shield Skeleton to its knees. Its once-impenetrable defense had been critically weakened, its shield cracked and its armor battered.
The system confirmed the result.
[The Target Defense Reduced by 40%].
Galactron, however, remained unscathed. He smirked as he hovered above the destruction, clearly unfazed.
"Broken!" Frostedge shouted from a distance. "I'll buy you four seconds!"
Broken, already preparing to unleash his Bedrock Breaker Pickaxe, paused briefly in surprise.
Frostedge wasn't just stepping in to assist—he had precisely anticipated Broken's next move, down to the time required for him to charge his skill.
It caught Broken off guard. How does he even know that?

Sure, Broken had used this attack during the Deadbay War, but he hadn't expected Frostedge to have watched or analyzed those battles so carefully. And while it wasn't exactly four seconds—more like a little over—Frostedge's calculation highlighted just how keenly attuned he was to the situation.
Even four seconds wasn't an easy window to secure in a fight like this.
Broken focused, gripping his weapon tightly.
[Explosive Arrow (Active Skill) Lv. 5]
The charging process began, and a glowing duplicate of the pickaxe appeared behind him, spinning wildly in the air.
The Elite Skeleton Warriors, now fully reassembled, started to close in.
Frostedge, meanwhile, took action. He hurled his sword into the air, the blade glowing as it rapidly expanded into a massive ice sword, many times its original size.

The enormous blade hovered momentarily before slamming into the Greatsword Skeleton, locking it in a one-on-one battle. The ice sword moved as though controlled by an invisible hand, engaging in a fierce duel with the skeleton's massive weapon.
With each clash, shards of ice burst outward, pelting the skeleton and disrupting its movements, making it visibly less fluid than before.
Simultaneously, Frostedge darted and weaved, evading the relentless attacks of the Mage Skeleton and the Archer Skeleton.
How is he even doing this? Broken wondered, briefly glancing up.
Frostedge was managing to coordinate two battles at once, dodging projectiles with uncanny precision while keeping the Greatsword Skeleton locked in combat through the ice sword's relentless assault.
It wasn't just skill—it was absolute mastery of control!
While the Shield Skeleton was still recovering from the earlier devastating attack, the Axe Skeleton was free to act.
With incredible speed for its massive size, the Axe Skeleton charged toward Frostedge, its Massive Battle Axe swinging wildly in devastating arcs, aiming to cut him down.

Frostedge detonated ice at his feet, propelling himself out of the axe's path with pinpoint precision. Each swing narrowly missed him, the sheer force of the attacks leaving deep gouges in the ground.
The Axe Skeleton didn't let up, continuing its relentless assault. Its swings were a combination of brute strength and terrifying speed.
But Frostedge was even faster.
With a trail of shimmering ice forming behind him, he launched himself into the air, maneuvering with breathtaking agility.

Explosions of ice jolted him from one direction to another, his movements fluid and unpredictable. Each detonation allowed him to dodge the axe's wild swings with perfect timing, as if he were skating through the air itself.
How? Just how is he managing all of this?!
Those watching the battle could only gape in stunned silence at Frostedge's masterful control and precision.
Meanwhile, the massive ice sword he had summoned continued its brutal duel with the Greatsword Skeleton.
At the same time, Frostedge created dozens of ice disc shields in midair, each one forming to intercept the projectiles fired by the Mage Skeleton and the Archer Skeleton.
And yet, even while blocking those attacks, he continued to evade the Axe Skeleton's swings, twisting and leaping through the air with explosive bursts of ice from his feet.
It was an unbelievable display. The sheer multitasking and skill required to juggle all these elements at once was staggering.
This wasn't just fighting—this was an art form!
Frostedge wasn't just holding his own; he was dominating the battlefield, creating openings for Broken while keeping the skeletons completely occupied.
"This guy is insane," Forev said.
"Damn, I can't help but admit it. He's nuts. What the hell is going on inside that guy's head?" RememberMe muttered, shaking his head.
"Do you think he also needs a fancy electric car and a mobile home bus to complete the package?" PussyCat added with a chuckle.
"No wonder, he's such a fan favorite among players from his country," Freya remarked.
[Hadrius]: "Frostedge is literally skating circles around a giant axe-wielding skeleton while blocking projectiles and dueling another with an ice sword?? HOW??"
[Logan_Schmittka]: "This isn't gameplay. This is an ART EXHIBITION. Frostedge is insane!"
[Tony_Faunce]: "Did you SEE how he dodged that axe?! It's like he knows the moves before they happen!"
[Luis_Mucito]: "This is the kind of gameplay that makes me question if I'll EVER get good at this game."
[am_s]: "That ice sword fighting a skeleton like it's sentient while he skates and dodges?! Absolute chills—pun intended."
The charging time of Explosive Arrow was complete.

None of this would have been possible without the flawless performance of Frostedge. His dazzling skill had created the perfect window, holding off the skeletons ensuring Broken had the precious seconds needed to charge his skill.
With a deep breath, Broken released the bowstring.

chapters.title: Chapter 664: When Two Champions Collide with Death
paragraphs: The ground shook violently, a deafening quake that cracked the desert. Massive chunks of earth rose into the air, creating a chaotic battlefield of floating, crumbling platforms. Massive boulders rained down, crashing into the ground with earth-shattering explosions, sending plumes of sand and debris flying into the sky.

The battlefield was completely consumed by the chaos-layer upon layer of destruction, so dense that it became impossible to see what was happening in the heart of it all. The air itself seemed thick with sand and energy, leaving the outcome shrouded in uncertainty.
"This fight is insane," Forev muttered.
"Ch, if only we could do something to at least help," RememberMe said.
"No way!" Forev snapped back, shaking her head. "Even getting close would be suicide. Just one hit from those elite skeletons, and we'd be dead instantly."
Freya sighed. "This Necromancer is a real cockroach... rumor has it he's never died in this game. Not even once."
Pussycat chimed in. "But this fight is a nightmare. Even with Broken and Frostedge working together, it's not getting any easier."
Freya nodded. "More like, none of them can actually kill each other. It's just a matter of dragging this fight out as long as possible."
"Ch," RememberMe growled, clenching his fists. "This little piece of shit is really pissing me off."
The Shield Skeleton was down! At least that was some good news for Broken-the relentless barrage from his last attack had finally paid off.
One less obstacle stood in their way.
If they could just push harder, they might finally turn the tide.

While the remaining elite skeletons were still recovering, their reassembly rapid but not instant, Frostedge seized the moment. He darted toward Galactron, his intent clear-the Necromancer was the linchpin of this battle, and eliminating him was the key to victory.
Broken followed, sprinting after Frostedge to back him up.

But Galactron wasn't about to let them get close. The remaining elite skeletons completed their recovery faster than expected. Almost instantly, a barrage of arrows and magic missiles launched toward Frostedge, forcing him to veer sharply to avoid the cascading explosions that followed.
The chase toward Galactron was cut short.

A fresh round of combat began, but this time, the Greatsword Skeleton was focused on Frostedge. It charged after him with relentless precision, its heavy blade slicing through the air with brutal force.
It was clear-Galactron had shifted his strategy.

Instead of splitting attention between the two fighters, the Necromancer directed the bulk of his assault toward Frostedge. Physical attack after physical attack rained down on him, forcing the magic sword fighter into a defensive strategy.

Unlike Broken, Frostedge wasn't built for enduring prolonged physical combat. His Intelligence-based build made him an exceptional offensive player and a master of crowd control, but his durability was far lower than Broken's Strength-based resilience.
Frostedge can't take too many direct hits!
Even with his skill and agility, Frostedge was clearly being pushed to his limits, forced to dodge and counter as the Greatsword Skeleton pressed its advantage.
Broken would have to act quickly if they were to stop the momentum Galactron was building.

The battle raged on, each side unleashing brutal skills and devastating attacks. The clash showed no signs of ending anytime soon, with Broken and Frostedge locked in their desperate struggle against Galactron and his relentless summons.
Meanwhile, RememberMe and the others stayed at a safe distance, observing the chaos unfold. They could only watch, powerless to intervene.
"Looks like I need to get serious about leveling up and strengthening myself," RememberMe muttered.
"Yeah, you rich players should actually become strong for once," Freya quipped with a smirk. "So you can join in during moments like this."
Pussycat chuckled softly. "I never thought the day would come where RememberMe had to take this game seriously."
"Damn it!" RememberMe exclaimed. "I think I need to aim for Divine Champion status too!"
Forev, without even glancing at him, delivered a dry response: "Go hunt down those Divine Champions and steal their blessings."
RememberMe groaned. "Why does that actually sound tempting?"
The battle reached its most intense and jaw-dropping phase yet.
The Elite Summons-massive, terrifying, and relentless-were finally defeated!
It was an exhausting, hard-won victory that left everyone watching in awe.

Now, the path was clear: Broken and Frostedge had to take down Galactron, once and for all. From a distance, Galactron stood unmoved, his flat expression giving way to a slight chuckle. With a calm lift of his hands, dozens-no, hundreds of magic circles appeared across the battlefield. From them emerged an uncountable horde of skeletal warriors, immediately charging toward the two fighters like an unstoppable wave of death.

Frostedge didn't hesitate. He skated across the battlefield, his every motion fluid and precise. Spikes of ice erupted in his wake, spearing the skeletal warriors as they advanced. Dozens fell with every second, but the endless swarm kept coming.

Amidst the chaos, Frostedge's movement seemed to signal something to Broken. The floating ice platforms that he conjured in the air appeared almost intentionally placed, and Broken quickly understood the assignment.

Summoning his Moonvine Knuckles, Broken swung forward, launching vines that wrapped tightly around the floating chunks of ice. Using them as grapple points, he propelled himself into the air with incredible speed, rapidly closing the gap between himself and Galactron.

Below, Frostedge continued his relentless assault, spinning and slashing as ice crescent waves radiated from his sword. Each wave cut through the swarm of skeletal warriors, freezing and shattering dozens at a time.
Even as the skeletal army charged from every direction, Frostedge didn't falter, his ice element control turning the battlefield into a frozen graveyard.
Above, Broken swung from one ice platform to another, gaining momentum with each leap.

The skeletal archers and mages targeted Broken relentlessly, arrows and spells flying through the air in a desperate attempt to halt his advance. He deflected what he could, but the hail of projectiles made every swing a dangerous gamble.

As Broken closed in, Galactron floated further away, his grimoire glowing brighter as it continued summoning reinforcements. The endless tide of skeletons, archers, and mages grew thicker, their combined attacks creating a near-impossible barrier to break through.

The battlefield was pure chaos. Frostedge and Broken were pushing their limits, but Galactron's strategy of overwhelming numbers was beginning to take its toll. Still, neither fighter showed any signs of giving up.
This was their moment-and they weren't going to waste it!

Frostedge pushed himself harder, skating through waves of skeletal warriors. Every slash of his blade sent out crescent-shaped waves of ice energy, shattering skeletons in his path. He forced his way closer and closer to Galactron, ignoring the relentless swarm trying to slow him down.

At the same time, Broken launched himself with incredible speed, swinging from the floating ice platforms. He used the last one to propel himself past Galactron, landing on the opposite side of the battlefield. Without missing a beat, Broken summoned his Wavebreaker Spear, gripping it tightly as he prepared to strike.
From opposite directions, Broken and Frostedge charged at Galactron in perfect synchronization.

The Necromancer, floating at the center of the chaos, seemed momentarily trapped. Rushing hordes of skeletal warriors surrounded them, but the two fighters were undeterred, their focus locked solely on their target.

Frostedge's icy trail gleamed behind him as he closed the distance. On the other side, Broken's spear crackled with water element, its sharp tip pointed directly at Galactron. They both leaped simultaneously, their weapons ready to deliver a decisive, final blow. Everyone watching the battle, both on the ground and through the Vensalor Guild Official Channel, leaned forward in anticipation. Breath caught in their throats.
This was it. This had to work!
"Galactron is cornered! He has to die!" RememberMe exclaimed.
Forev nodded, sharing the sentiment.
But Freya shook her head slowly. "I wish for the same," she said.
The tension was unbearable. Would this be the end of Galactron, or did the Necromancer have another trick up his sleeve?
I put everything into making this battle as impactful and efficient as possible, but scenes like this one are absolutely essential.
When facing an opponent like Galactron-a powerhouse Necromancer with seemingly endless reinforcements-you can't expect a quick or simple fight.
This clash had to showcase the grit, strategy, and sheer determination of Broken and Frostedge as they pushed themselves to their limits.
Thank you for reading and for sticking with me through these intense and chaotic battles!

Even as the skeletal army charged from every direction, Frostedge didn't falter, his ice element control turning the battlefield into a frozen graveyard.
Above, Broken swung from one ice platform to another, gaining momentum with each leap.
The skeletal archers and mages targeted Broken relentlessly, arrows and spells flying through the air in a desperate attempt to halt his advance.
He deflected what he could, but the hail of projectiles made every swing a dangerous gamble.
As Broken closed in, Galactron floated further away, his grimoire glowing brighter as it continued summoning reinforcements.
The endless tide of skeletons, archers, and mages grew thicker, their combined attacks creating a near-impossible barrier to break through.
The battlefield was pure chaos.
Frostedge and Broken were pushing their limits, but Galactron's strategy of overwhelming numbers was beginning to take its toll.
Still, neither fighter showed any signs of giving up.
This was their moment-and they weren't going to waste it!
Frostedge pushed himself harder, skating through waves of skeletal warriors.
Every slash of his blade sent out crescent-shaped waves of ice energy, shattering skeletons in his path.
He forced his way closer and closer to Galactron, ignoring the relentless swarm trying to slow him down.
At the same time, Broken launched himself with incredible speed, swinging from the floating ice platforms.
He used the last one to propel himself past Galactron, landing on the opposite side of the battlefield.
Without missing a beat, Broken summoned his Wavebreaker Spear, gripping it tightly as he prepared to strike.
From opposite directions, Broken and Frostedge charged at Galactron in perfect synchronization.
The Necromancer, floating at the center of the chaos, seemed momentarily trapped.
Rushing hordes of skeletal warriors surrounded them, but the two fighters were undeterred, their focus locked solely on their target.
Frostedge's icy trail gleamed behind him as he closed the distance.
On the other side, Broken's spear crackled with water element, its sharp tip pointed directly at Galactron.
They both leaped simultaneously, their weapons ready to deliver a decisive, final blow.
Everyone watching the battle, both on the ground and through the Vensalor Guild Official Channel, leaned forward in anticipation.
Breath caught in their throats.
This was it.
This had to work!
"Galactron is cornered!
He has to die!" RememberMe exclaimed.
Forev nodded, sharing the sentiment.
But Freya shook her head slowly.
"I wish for the same," she said.
The tension was unbearable.
Would this be the end of Galactron, or did the Necromancer have another trick up his sleeve?
I put everything into making this battle as impactful and efficient as possible, but scenes like this one are absolutely essential.
When facing an opponent like Galactron-a powerhouse Necromancer with seemingly endless reinforcements-you can't expect a quick or simple fight.
This clash had to showcase the grit, strategy, and sheer determination of Broken and Frostedge as they pushed themselves to their limits.
Thank you for reading and for sticking with me through these intense and chaotic battles!

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - The Necromancer’s Vanishing Act
paragraphs: Broken and Frostedge were moments away from landing their first direct hits on Galactron.
The Wavebreaker Spear and Frostedge's sword closed in, poised to deliver a devastating blow—a combination of physical and magical damage.
Galactron appeared utterly unprotected, with no magic shield to guard him. This was it.
Just as the spear and sword were about to strike his neck, Galactron smiled faintly.
Their instincts flared to life. Both Broken and Frostedge halted their attacks mid-swing, leaping backward just in time.

A massive explosion of green and shadow energy erupted from Galactron, unleashing a violent force that sent ripples across the battlefield. In an instant, dozens—no, hundreds—of skeletons materialized around him.
"Damn it!" Broken growled. "Is he really this hard to kill?!"

But something was different this time. The skeletal warriors didn't charge at them. Instead, they converged on Galactron, wrapping themselves tightly around him to form a massive cocoon of bone and shadow, encasing the Necromancer completely.
Broken immediately swapped out his Wavebreaker Spear for the Bedrock Breaker Pickaxe, understanding what needed to be done.
At the same moment, Frostedge launched himself back into the fray.
"Broken, he's going to teleport away!" Frostedge shouted.
Broken nodded grimly and activated his skill.
[Terra Fury (Active Skill) activated.]
[Unleashes the full power of the earth, dealing 2000% physical damage to a single target and causing a series of aftershocks that deal 1000% physical damage to all nearby enemies.]
Broken slammed the pickaxe into the cocoon with all his might, the ground beneath them trembling violently from the impact.

Frostedge followed up immediately, unleashing a massive slash of icy energy, freezing the cocoon as his attacks struck repeatedly. The battlefield was consumed by a storm of shattering ice, waves of destruction, and booming impacts.
BBBB-BOOM! BBB-BOOM! CR-STRAKC—CRASH!

The combined power of their attacks sent both fighters hurtling backward, the force of their own efforts throwing them off balance. The skeletal cocoon shattered into pieces, bones scattering across the battlefield in every direction.
Then, the shattered skeleton pieces began to sink into the ground, disappearing as though being swallowed by the earth itself.
When the dust settled, their target—Galactron—was gone.
Broken scanned the area, his grip tightening on his weapon. There was no sign of the Necromancer, no trace of his presence. Frostedge, breathing heavily, also confirmed there was nothing left.
The battle was over.
Despite their relentless efforts, they had failed to kill Galactron.
Even with the combined might of two Divine Champions and a Unique-grade Class wielder, the cunning Necromancer had slipped through their grasp.
But if Galactron possessed an escape skill as powerful as this—an instantaneous teleportation ability—then just how could anyone hope to kill him?
With his overwhelming offensive potential, combined with his incredible mobility and near-perfect escape mechanisms, Galactron wasn't just a powerful opponent.
He was a monster.
Broken turned toward Frostedge, letting out a sigh and shaking his head.
Frostedge chuckled softly. "We lost him."
"He's got plenty of tricks up his sleeve," Broken replied.
Frostedge nodded. "This was my first time fighting him."
Broken tilted his head slightly. "He's the Guild Master of a top guild. Aren't you worried they'll come after you for getting involved in this mess?"

Frostedge smirked and shook his head. "I'd actually welcome it. No, scratch that—I'd be thrilled if they came after me," he said before pausing. "What I mean is... I love these kinds of high-intensity battles. If they can offer something interesting, I wouldn't mind at all."
"You've got some interesting tastes, Frostedge."
Frostedge gave a polite bow. "Anyway, thanks for the opportunity. It's been... fun."
Broken and Frostedge exchanged quiet laughs after the intense battle.
Though they had failed to defeat their opponent, the fight itself had been nothing short of breathtaking.
It was their first time working as a duo, yet their synergy had been remarkable. Despite the chaos, the battle unfolded with a sense of precision that highlighted their strengths.

Frostedge had showcased his exceptional skill and versatility, offering crucial support to Broken while ensuring the overall flow of the fight remained strategic and controlled. His contributions were seamless, a testament to his mastery.
He had lived up to his legendary reputation, and not once did it falter.
Not long after, RememberMe and the others approached, joining Broken and Frostedge amidst the aftermath of the battle.
"Woah, that was an insanely cool fight!" RememberMe exclaimed. "Hahaha, you guys should've seen how hyped everyone was watching it live!"
Broken and Frostedge turned to face them as Freya spoke up.
"Well," she said with a casual shrug, "Frostedge, we'll be sharing the broadcast revenue with you, of course."
Frostedge blinked, looking slightly surprised. "But..."
"No worries," Freya interrupted with a small grin. "I'll even share some of it with Galactron.
Broken frowned, raising an eyebrow. "I didn't realize that was necessary."
Freya chuckled lightly. "It's not about necessity. I doubt Galactron even cares about the money. This is more about... keeping things smooth, you know? Just to avoid any unnecessary trouble."
"Everything okay on that front?"
Freya winked. "No worries! I'm great at handling things like this. Consider it handled."

Broken summoned Beebot once more, and the group climbed aboard the crawling carriage. Now loaded with six passengers, the vehicle creaked slightly under the added weight but moved steadily across the desert.
As they settled in, Broken turned to Freya. "What's the overall progress?"

Freya nodded, bringing up several floating screens in front of them. The displays showed updates from the capital, including the intense battle where Ivana and Elincia were engaged against one of the Horde of Hell's members.
"Pawpaw mentioned earlier that Princess Alora is in danger."
Freya gave a quick nod. "Yes, there's a strong chance she's being confronted by one of the Gluttony Champions, too."
"Who's most likely to be it?"

Freya paused, considering for a moment. "If their goal is to delay and stall for time, I'd guess it's SpeedGang, the one you defeated a while back. He's perfect for this kind of tactic—setting up a domain that restricts everything and tips the scales entirely in his favor."
Broken nodded, his gaze narrowing. "That might explain why Lionell and Mercy haven't been able to assist Princess Alora."
Freya sighed. "If that's the case, it means they're playing a long game to isolate and drag things out. And SpeedGang's domains are notorious for being nearly impossible to break."
Their attention shifted back to the floating screen, where Elincia and Ivana were locked in battle with Akiko.
"These Gluttony Champions are such a pain in the ass," RememberMe muttered, crossing his arms in frustration.
"We need to figure out how her blessing works," Forev added.
The group watched as the battle unfolded, their eyes narrowing at every move Akiko made.
"With Ivana's defensive skills, they shouldn't be taking heavy hits from someone like Akiko," Freya observed.
"But..." she continued, "her mysterious blessing is somehow nullifying their attacks entirely. Nothing they do seems to work on her."
"Just how?" Freya sighed. "We need to figure out how her power works and find a way to counter it."
RememberMe, still watching the fight, suddenly turned toward Frostedge, who was sitting quietly at the back of the carriage.
"Hey, man," RememberMe called out. "Have you ever fought someone like her? Or maybe her specifically? Do you have any idea how her blessing works?"
All eyes turned to Frostedge, waiting to see if the swordsman had an insight that could turn the tide.

chapters.title: Chapter 666: Striking From Above and Below
paragraphs: Elincia and Ivana vs Akiko.

Elincia finally decided to stay on the ground, standing close to Ivana, who kept a magic shield up to protect her. Their opponent, Akiko, floated above them, her bat-like wings flapping steadily as she looked down on them.
"Didn't I tell you?" Akiko sneered. "I just wanted to chat, but you two insisted on fighting me. And for what? It's all a waste of effort."

Elincia had thrown everything she had at Akiko earlier, casting magic attack after magic attack, but all of them had been neutralized by Akiko's wings. The constant futility had left her frustrated and emotionally drained.
Now, she'd retreated to the ground, recovering under Ivana's protective skills, while her mind raced with possibilities.

Elincia had a few theories about how Akiko's Gluttony Champion powers worked, but putting them to the test was proving to be nearly impossible. Akiko's agility and mobility were off the charts-she darted and flew effortlessly across the battlefield, evading every attempt to pin her down.

No matter how hard Elincia and Ivana tried, not a single attack had managed to land. The frustration was overwhelming. This fight wasn't just draining their energy-it was pushing Elincia's patience and emotions to their breaking point.

They couldn't let this drag on any longer. Akiko's purpose was clear-to stop Elincia and Ivana from reaching the capital. If they continued defending like this, the battle would never end. The only option left was to kill her, and fast.
"Elincia, do you have another idea?" Ivana asked.
"Yes," Elincia replied. "Let's try again, but this time, you attack her directly."
"How?"
"Go at her while holding your shield."
Ivana hesitated for only a moment before nodding. "Okay."

As they prepared their next move, Elincia received an update through the guild channel about Broken and Frostedge's battle with Galactron. She sighed heavily, the weight of the enemy's coordinated efforts pressing on her.
"They're really serious about this plan," she muttered to herself.
Elincia floated into the air again, then darted far back across the battlefield.
Akiko's eyes locked onto her immediately. "Oh, trying to run?" she sneered, flapping her wings to chase after Elincia.
Meanwhile, Ivana acted. She hurled her shield with incredible speed, the weapon spinning through the air with a loud whoosh that cut through the battlefield's tension.
The shield raced past Akiko in a blur.
Suddenly, Ivana appeared right behind it, gripping the shield firmly in midair. Using her perfect momentum, she swung the shield with all her strength, aiming directly at Akiko.

Akiko raised both her swords, crossing them in defense, but the impact was devastating. The clash sent a deafening shockwave through the air, and Akiko's body was hurled backward, crashing into the sky.
It worked!

Akiko, however, was already recovering. Flames mixed with shadows erupted around her body, her aura blazing with renewed intensity. She shot forward with blistering speed, her movements a blur as she nullified Ivana's second attempt to attack.
Akiko lunged at Ivana, aiming to strike her down, but Ivana maneuvered gracefully. She leapt forward, positioning herself for another attack. With her shield raised high, she swung down hard.
The collision was massive. Another clash sent shockwaves across the battlefield, and once again, Akiko was hurled violently through the air.
The realization hit them: direct physical attacks worked. They had found a way to break through Akiko's overwhelming defenses.
[Elincia]: "Turns out your theory was right, Freya."
[Freya]: "Yes, but Ivana will still struggle to kill her. Akiko can keep flying above her, and Ivana can only attack once before falling back to the ground."
[Elincia]: "Exactly. And if I stay grounded, Akiko doesn't come close-she just hovers and stalls for time. This bitch is really testing my patience."
[RememberMe]: "I'm going to interrogate Frostedge. I'm sure he knows something about Akiko—or at least has a theory."
[Freya]: "Ck! Show him a little respect, RememberMe. He's not someone who'd act against his principles so easily."
[RememberMe]: "Such a pain. He's already teamed up with Broken against Galactron, though."
[Elincia]: "Has he given you any answers?"
[Freya]: "No."

Freya crossed her arms, continuing. "But if Akiko is really immune to magic damage and can nullify Ivana's shield throw... doesn't it seem like she has some kind of immunity to long- range attacks in general?"
[Elincia]: "That's exactly what I've been suspecting too."

[Freya]: "And no power is without weaknesses. Maybe her blessing only works against attacks cast or launched from a certain range. If we can figure out that threshold, we might be able to exploit it."
[Elincia]: "I've tried attacking from range multiple times, and she always closes in to disrupt me. Let's test it again and confirm."

Elincia floated across the battlefield, her breaths uneven as she desperately tried to evade Akiko, who was relentless in her pursuit. Despite Ivana's best efforts to intercept, Akiko's unmatched agility made her nearly impossible to stop.

Elincia felt utterly helpless in a situation like this. As a pure Mage who relied entirely on Magic Damage, she was completely outmatched. If Akiko could indeed nullify long-range attacks, it meant that Elincia couldn't deal any meaningful damage at all.

And it didn't stop there. Akiko's physical damage output, combined with her overwhelming speed and mobility, made her an unstoppable force. Even Elincia's magic shields were rendered useless, as this infuriating woman nullified those as well!
Oh, motherfucker! Elincia cursed inwardly, her frustration bubbling to the surface. This wasn't just a difficult fight—it was downright unfair!
"Elincia!" Ivana shouted, appearing just in time to block Akiko's next attack. She swung her shield with precision, narrowly stopping a brutal strike aimed at Elincia.
The Gluttony Champion was relentless. She twisted through the air, breaking past Ivana's defenses with startling ease.
[Freya]: "She won't let Elincia get away. I think we're right about her strategy."
Ivana managed a strong counterattack, swinging her shield downward with crushing force.
The blow sent Akiko crashing to the ground with a resounding impact.
A streak of lightning followed swiftly, Elincia's attack aimed directly at Akiko. But before it could hit, Akiko darted away with terrifying speed, avoiding the strike entirely.
[Freya]: "She dodged Elincia's attack!"
In the next moment, Akiko closed the gap once more, her speed overwhelming. Ivana was a second too late to intercept.
"Damn it, am I really dying here?! Hell no way!" Elincia growled, frustration and panic rising in her voice.

Akiko's attack was lethal-a decisive skill that would be fatal if it landed. Elincia had no way to defend herself. Her shields were useless, and she couldn't possibly outspeed Akiko's terrifying flight. A direct hit from this woman would mean instant death.
Oh, come on! I haven't even joined the real battle yet!
Elincia's thoughts raced as the swords closed in.
But just as Akiko raised her blades to strike, something whirled through the air with incredible speed. The sound was deafening, like a storm tearing through the battlefield.
Before Akiko could react, the object slammed into her with brutal force, sending her hurtling backward.
She hit the ground hard, her wings folding as her body went completely still.
A moment later, her form began to shatter into pixels, dissipating into the air as she was defeated-instantaneously and without warning.
The object that had struck her became clear as it continued spinning wildly: a massive hammer glowing faintly with energy. It spiraled through the air before twisting and spinning away.
"Who was that?!" Freya shouted from inside the carriage.
"I'm pretty sure he came for Ivana," Broken said.

"Elincia!" Ivana shouted, appearing just in time to block Akiko's next attack.
She swung her shield with precision, narrowly stopping a brutal strike aimed at Elincia.
The Gluttony Champion was relentless.
She twisted through the air, breaking past Ivana's defenses with startling ease.
[Freya]: "She won't let Elincia get away.
I think we're right about her strategy."
Ivana managed a strong counterattack, swinging her shield downward with crushing force.
The blow sent Akiko crashing to the ground with a resounding impact.
A streak of lightning followed swiftly, Elincia's attack aimed directly at Akiko.
But before it could hit, Akiko darted away with terrifying speed, avoiding the strike entirely.
[Freya]: "She dodged Elincia's attack!"
In the next moment, Akiko closed the gap once more, her speed overwhelming.
Ivana was a second too late to intercept.
"Damn it, am I really dying here?!
Hell no way!" Elincia growled, frustration and panic rising in her voice.
Akiko's attack was lethal-a decisive skill that would be fatal if it landed.
Elincia had no way to defend herself.
Her shields were useless, and she couldn't possibly outspeed Akiko's terrifying flight.
A direct hit from this woman would mean instant death.
Oh, come on!
I haven't even joined the real battle yet!
Elincia's thoughts raced as the swords closed in.
But just as Akiko raised her blades to strike, something whirled through the air with incredible speed.
The sound was deafening, like a storm tearing through the battlefield.
Before Akiko could react, the object slammed into her with brutal force, sending her hurtling backward.
She hit the ground hard, her wings folding as her body went completely still.
A moment later, her form began to shatter into pixels, dissipating into the air as she was defeated-instantaneously and without warning.
The object that had struck her became clear as it continued spinning wildly: a massive hammer glowing faintly with energy.
It spiraled through the air before twisting and spinning away.
"Who was that?!" Freya shouted from inside the carriage.
"I'm pretty sure he came for Ivana," Broken said.

chapters.title: Chapter 667: Fire vs. Fists
paragraphs: Western Gate.
Optimus, Trison, and Toberry vs King Balam.
Optimus moved with relentless speed, leaping into the air and delivering a powerful punch that sent the demon blocking his path flying.

With barely a pause, he followed up with an overhead kick, slamming another demon to the ground. His movements were fluid and precise, darting from one enemy to the next, weaving through the horde of demons surrounding him.

Behind him, Trison, with his impressive agility, dodged and danced around attacks, providing critical support from the rear. Meanwhile, Toberry, visibly frustrated, struggled to keep up with the duo's chaotic fighting style.
"Optimus...!" Toberry shouted, breathless. "Wait for me! Don't move so fast!"

Moments later, the three of them stood together, facing the towering figure of King Balam. The massive demon, with his bull's head and fiery greatsword, loomed over them like a living mountain. His glowing eyes glanced down.
[King Balam - Elder Hellborn Lv. 270]
[Named Demon - Ranking 51]
"Trash, daring to face me directly?"

Trison tossed a flask into the air, the liquid inside spinning wildly as it burst into a stream of water, splashing over Optimus. Simultaneously, Toberry began hurling bottles of various elixirs, each one shattering near Optimus and releasing clouds of potent buffs.
"Fire resistance, speed boost, strength boost, health regeneration, antidote..." Toberry muttered under his breath, the list going on as he poured everything into empowering their strongest fighter.
"Hah!" Optimus exhaled, his body now glowing with an intense white energy. His stance shifted, his knees bending slightly, as he grinned faintly-a predator ready to strike.

Boosted beyond his limits, Optimus launched himself forward like a bullet, closing the distance to King Balam in a blink. The colossal demon roared, raising his massive, flame- engulfed greatsword high, ready to meet the challenge.
While Trison and Toberry were left behind, the two quickly found themselves swarmed by a horde of monsters closing in from all directions.
Trison, with his exceptional speed and agility, darted around effortlessly, leaping over attacks and dodging with precision.
Meanwhile, Toberry was having a much harder time. His movements were clumsy, and he stumbled as he ran, struggling to avoid the monsters' relentless attacks.
"Trison! Help me! I'm going to die here!" Toberry cried out.
Trison glanced back, sighing. "Sorry, Toberry! You need to hang on. I can't stop running, or I'll get overwhelmed too!
"Everyone! Someone, please help me!" Toberry shouted desperately.
A group of players battling nearby heard his plea.
"Hey, Toberry needs help! Let's move!" one shouted.
"Yeah, Optimus needs him for support. We have to shield him!" another added.
The group charged toward Toberry, but as they neared, a wave of monsters intercepted them. The attackers were ferocious, and several players were quickly cut down, their bodies falling to the ground.
Toberry, still dodging and rolling to avoid the swarming beasts, looked back, horrified.
"Oh, come on! Why are you dying so easily?!" he yelled.
Despite the mounting chaos, a few players managed to break through and form a protective circle around Toberry.
"I need to keep supporting Optimus! Please, keep these monsters off me!" Toberry pleaded as he fumbled with his potions, throwing out buffs wherever he could.
"Got it! We'll cover you as best we can!" one of the players responded, rallying the group to hold their ground.

Optimus shot forward with blinding speed, closing the distance to King Balam in an instant. The towering demon let out a booming laugh, gripping his massive greatsword before slamming it into the ground with immense force.
But Optimus was faster. His body blurred as he dodged the attack-not teleporting, but moving with such incredible speed it was almost impossible to track.

With precision and momentum, Optimus leapt onto the greatsword itself, dashing up its length at breakneck speed. Within seconds, he was floating directly in front of King Balam's face, his fist drawn back for a devastating strike.
B-B-BOAM!!!
The impact reverberated through the battlefield as Optimus's punch connected with the demon's face, forcing the massive creature to stagger back slightly.
Not letting up, Optimus surged forward again, delivering a barrage of punches to King Balam's face. The demon roared, flames erupting from his mouth in an attempt to engulf the agile fighter.
But Optimus spun midair, twisting away from the fire and landing on the ground with a heavy
BOOM.

Harnessing the momentum, he rocketed toward the demon's legs, aiming for its foundation. His strikes were a blur-powerful punches and brutal kicks that hit with relentless precision. Optimus's combination of speed and strength turned him into an unstoppable force.
In a final bold move, Optimus grabbed hold of King Balam's massive leg, his muscles straining as he attempted to lift and slam the demon.
King Balam roared in defiance, raising his massive greatsword and swinging it down toward Optimus.

With a sudden burst of speed, Optimus vanished, reappearing on the other side in an instant. He leapt onto the demon's massive left arm, running up its length. With flawless execution, he launched a series of precise kicks to King Balam's face, forcing the demon's head to tilt to the side from the repeated impact.
The demon let out a furious roar, and his entire body ignited in a fiery explosion, sending a wave of energy rippling outward.
Optimus was flung backward, the force of the blast hurling him across the battlefield.
Trison and Toberry, watching from a distance, immediately broke into a sprint to follow where Optimus landed.

When they reached him, Optimus's body was scorched, flames still lingering across his armor. Without hesitation, the two supports began their work-healing and buffing the fighter back to peak condition.
As the fiery energy subsided, Optimus rose to his feet, his eyes locked on King Balam.
With a faint grin, he bolted forward once more. His lightning-fast movements carried him straight back to King Balam, ready to continue the fight.
The battlefield was his stage, and the fight had only just begun.

[stripes8608]: "King Balam's like: 'I got fire, I got a sword,' and Optimus is like, 'Cool story,
bro,' punches face."
[Melvin_Nadler]: "No lie, Toberry needs a buff to his cardio stat. Man's out there sweating
like a level 1 scrub. []"

[Nathan_Nutter_1820]: "But damn... if Optimus gets the right support, he can go this crazy? He didn't perform like this in the Deadbay battle. This guy is seriously a monster!" [apocaliss]: "When King Balam roared and exploded, Optimus legit went, 'Wheeeeeeeeeee~' into the distance."
[KulRuninz]: "I'm not saying Optimus is OP, but the dude's basically an anime protagonist
now."
