chapters.title: Chapter 668: Abyss Devourer
paragraphs: Eastern Gate.
Goldrich and Jovina vs Countess Murmur.

Countess Murmur hovered just above the ground. Unlike most demons, she looked surprisingly human. Without horns, she carried an air of nobility that seemed almost regal. Still, her presence was anything but subtle. The ornate armor she wore, the magic staff in her hand, and her grand, feathered wings left no doubt about her power.
[Countess Murmur - Void Feathered Seraphim Lv. 263]
[Named Demon - Ranking 54]
In front of her stood two challengers: an old mage and a summoner.
The mage gave a small, respectful bow. "Goldrich sends his regards to the renowned Countess Murmur."
"Pathetic worms," the demoness said.
"Not exactly the most gracious way to acknowledge a polite greeting, wouldn't you agree, Countess?"
"Show me if you can provide even a shred of entertainment before I truly lose my patience and end this war myself."
"You're rushing things," Goldrich remarked. "We still have plenty of troops on both sides who haven't even finished slaughtering each other yet."
"I could wipe them all out in moments if I wanted."
"I do enjoy such overconfidence," Goldrich said.
Stepping forward, Jovina jabbed a finger at the floating demoness. "Hey, bitch! You're in the wrong place to talk so big. I'll make sure today's the last day you take another breath!"
The Countess chuckled. "Oh, how delightful. Crushing arrogance like yours is one of my greatest pleasures."

The Countess let out a self-assured laugh, her voice echoing across the battlefield as she floated effortlessly in the air, weaving gracefully from side to side. With a wave of her magic staff, she conjured several magic circles behind her, ready to unleash devastation at her whim. "Now, tell me," she said with a mocking tone, "how exactly do you plan to fight me? I bet you can't even reach me."
Goldrich gave a faint smile. "You're not the only one here who can fly."
"Yeah. Let's show this bitch who we are."

Jovina responded with a faint smirk, stepping forward. Slowly, she summoned three massive magic circles around her-large enough to make it clear that whatever she was calling forth wouldn't be ordinary.
One by one, her summons emerged.
The first was a colossal, monstrous tarantula, its black-and-red body almost twice Jovina's height. Its legs were covered in thick armor. This was Arachlord. Let's simplify it to Tarantus.

The second was a humanoid creature with the distinct features of a bee. Its glossy wings glistened in the light, and its sleek, armored body resembled that of a masked hero. A powerful stinger tail curved behind it. This was Sky Snatcher, but let's call it Beeman.

The third summon appeared gracefully, its butterfly-like wings fluttering softly as it hovered above the ground. Its form combined the sleek body of an insect with the upper torso of a humanoid woman clad in elegant full-body armor. This was Umbraflyte. For simplicity, let's call it Nightwing.
The battlefield went silent for a moment as everyone, whether standing nearby or watching the live broadcast, stared in awe.
It was the first time Jovina had ever revealed these summons in front of an audience.
The Beeman and Nightwing hovered behind Jovina. Below them, the Tarantus crouched low.
"Now, I've brought my insect collection today, and trust me, they're hungry. They won't mind feasting on demon meat, you arrogant bitch."
With a sudden burst of speed, the Beeman launched forward, its wings beating so fast they became a blur.
The Nightwing followed, gliding elegantly through the air.

Meanwhile, Goldrich stood beside Jovina. He stepped forward-or rather, up. His foot landed on an invisible platform, then another, as he began to ascend into the air. It was a skill similar to one used by Melliandra, allowing the old mage to traverse the skies as though walking on a transparent staircase.
"Cover me from behind, Jovina."
"Sure, but no guarantees. And if you die in this battle, I swear I'll kill you myself."
Goldrich chuckled as he continued his ascent. "Fair enough."
The Beeman shot toward Countess Murmur with astounding speed, darting left and right in rapid bursts. Its movements were almost unpredictable as it closed the distance to its target.

Meanwhile, the Nightwing hovered gracefully behind, its butterfly-like wings scattering a shimmering dust-like energy into the air. The effect was immediate-Beeman's speed increased even further, its movements becoming sharper and faster as it pressed its assault. Countess Murmur, began to laugh maniacally. With a wave of her staff, she unleashed dozens of magic missiles from the glowing circles around her.

The Beeman darted through the air, slashing with its bladed arms as it skillfully dodged the incoming projectiles. Its movements were almost too fast for the missiles to track, leaving trails of afterimages as it closed in.
On the other side of the battlefield, Goldrich made his move. He wasn't merely flying-he was running through the air, as though the transparent platforms beneath him were solid ground.
With his magic staff spinning effortlessly in his hands, Goldrich conjured a barrage of magic missiles, sending them hurtling toward Countess Murmur with precise aim.
For a moment, the battlefield seemed surreal. The sheer flexibility and speed displayed by the old mage left everyone watching in stunned silence.
This wasn't just a display of power-it was a revelation. Goldrich, the seemingly frail and reserved elder, was revealing his true strength only for this kind of special moment.

The battlefield in the skies was a chaotic spectacle of explosions and relentless speed. Countess Murmur, weaving through the air while unleashing a relentless barrage of attacks from afar. Her magic missiles and bursts of energy hammered the Beeman, a close-range attacker that refused to back down.

Despite being struck repeatedly by the demoness's devastating blasts, the Beeman pressed on, its speed forcing Countess Murmur to stay on the defensive. Whenever the Beeman faltered, the Nightwing swooped in, scattering its shimmering energy and healing the humanoid bee instantly.

Goldrich, on the other hand, was also dealing with Countess Murmur's relentless attacks. Yet, the old man moved with surprising agility, leaping and soaring through the air with a faint, confident smile.
Occasionally, he even flipped midair to dodge her explosive blasts.
When the blasts grew too large to evade, he let himself free-fall for a moment before conjuring another floating platform beneath him. He'd use it to dash forward, keeping his momentum.
He didn't look anything like the typical mage with moves like these. All the while, as he darted through the air, he fired magic missiles in quick succession, matching Countess
Murmur's attacks blow for blow.
[Samuel_Monroe]: "A flying grandpa running in the air like he's on a treadmill... Goldrich is
GOATED. []"
[Justin_Joshuva]: "Countess Murmur's 'I'm too OP for this' energy really didn't age well. She's getting outplayed by a grandpa and a bug enthusiast."
On the ground, the Tarantus fired massive web projectiles that spiraled through the air. Each shot aimed to snare the demoness, its precision improving with every attempt.
Finally, a well-timed web attack struck its target, wrapping around Countess Murmur's wings and slowing her movements.
Unnoticed amidst the chaos, Goldrich continued his advance, closing the distance with ease.
As he reached an ideal position, the old mage smiled faintly, raising his hand with a decisive motion.
"Soulbind Prison!" he shouted.
In an instant, a glowing cube of golden energy materialized around Countess Murmur.
Goldrich's smirk widened as he spun his magic staff in a deliberate, fluid motion. The battlefield stilled for a heartbeat as a massive dark portal opened behind him, swirling with ominous energy.
The air grew thick, and a deep, guttural roar rumbled from the depths of the portal, shaking the ground beneath them.
Slowly, a monstrous head began to emerge. Its grotesque maw was lined with jagged, glowing green teeth, and shadowy mist coiled around its massive form like living smoke.
"Abyss Devourer!"
Countess Murmur's composure cracked as panic flashed across her face. She twisted and darted in the air, desperately trying to escape.

The monstrous creature let out another deafening roar. Its massive maw opened wide, releasing a cannon-like blast of green and shadowy energy. The beam surged forward, engulfing the Countess completely, swallowing her whole in its overwhelming power. [Laurence_Giles_9545]: "When Goldrich said 'Soulbind Prison' and then summoned the Abyss Devourer, I swear I heard the boss music start"
[JungleDan]: "Live Chat: 'Countess Murmur = mid-tier villain confirmed.' Bruh, don't jinx it,
we're not done yet! []<"
[Hunter581]: "Who needs Avengers when you have Grandpa Mage and Bug Lady absolutely
WORKING a demon?"
[Stephen_Blaine]: "Jovina's bugs = Pokémon, Goldrich = Final Fantasy, Countess Murmur =
Still downloading updates."

Unnoticed amidst the chaos, Goldrich continued his advance, closing the distance with ease.
As he reached an ideal position, the old mage smiled faintly, raising his hand with a decisive motion.
"Soulbind Prison!" he shouted.
In an instant, a glowing cube of golden energy materialized around Countess Murmur.
Goldrich's smirk widened as he spun his magic staff in a deliberate, fluid motion.
The battlefield stilled for a heartbeat as a massive dark portal opened behind him, swirling with ominous energy.
The air grew thick, and a deep, guttural roar rumbled from the depths of the portal, shaking the ground beneath them.
Slowly, a monstrous head began to emerge.
Its grotesque maw was lined with jagged, glowing green teeth, and shadowy mist coiled around its massive form like living smoke.
"Abyss Devourer!"
Countess Murmur's composure cracked as panic flashed across her face.
She twisted and darted in the air, desperately trying to escape.
The monstrous creature let out another deafening roar.
Its massive maw opened wide, releasing a cannon-like blast of green and shadowy energy.
The beam surged forward, engulfing the Countess completely, swallowing her whole in its overwhelming power.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - Blades of Wind vs Swords of Flame
paragraphs: Southern Gate.
Starfall and Livelywood vs Duke Alloces.

Duke Alloces was a demon slightly taller than an average human. His appearance was unmistakably demonic, with full armor engulfed in flames, two blazing swords, and a single wing on the left side of his back.
For some reason, this lizard-faced demon only had one wing. While the other two Named Demons could fly, Livelywood wondered if this one could as well.
[Duke Alloces - Blazing Legionnaires Lv. 265]
[Named Demon - Ranking 52]
Livelywood and Starfall had fought through countless demons and broken their barricades. Now, they stood face-to-face with the Named Demon, who was prepared with his dual swords.
"I see you've made it through those lowly demons just to meet me here. I have to commend you for that, ho ho ho!" the demon said.
He added. "But I'd be disappointed if all that hard work ended so quickly."
Livelywood grinned, his face full of energy as he readied his Unique-grade sword.
"Mr. Demon, I'm not sure if I can beat you," he admitted. "I'll just do my best to hold you off until my friends arrive."
"You won't survive," Alloces sneered. "The only reason you're still breathing is because of my mercy, ho ho ho! If I'd truly gone on a rampage, you'd already be in pieces under my blades."
"It would be an honor to face someone as powerful as a Named Demon."
"I like your attitude, human trash, ho ho ho!" Duke Alloces chuckled.
He lowered his head slightly, raised both swords, and glared at Livelywood with fiery eyes.
Livelywood's body was now surrounded by a green aura, wrapping around his gold and silver armor.
Starfall, standing beside him, said, "I'll make sure you can fight him without distractions, Livelywood. But remember, fall back if you feel overwhelmed."
"I'll do my best not to slow anyone down. Let's work together, Starfall."
"As always."
Livelywood grinned and dashed forward at incredible speed.

Alloces, on the other hand, charged with brutal moves, wildly swinging his dual swords through the air. The demon leaped, slashed, jumped again, spun on his hands, and kicked out before leaping once more, laughing maniacally.
"Ho ho ho!

Alloces sped toward Livelywood, his movements chaotic and unpredictable. Livelywood immediately shifted into a defensive stance, parrying strike after strike. The final parry sent him flipping backward through the air.

Alloces lunged again at blinding speed, but despite the demon's wild aggression, Livelywood matched him. His quick reflexes allowed him to parry, counter, and even dodge with precise movements—bending his body backward, sidestepping, or leaping away when needed.

Their fighting styles were starkly different. Alloces fought like a storm, his movements erratic but showcasing masterful control of his dual swords, which had an impressive range. His confidence made his attacks overwhelmingly offensive, creating frequent openings in his stance. Yet, Livelywood couldn't exploit even the tiniest gaps.
Opening! Barely there!
Livelywood suddenly surged forward, his legs wrapped in fierce wind energy, propelling him past Alloces' wide swing. He aimed for his first strike, rushing toward Alloces.
But—
Alloces grinned wickedly, opened his mouth, and unleashed a massive blast of fire. Livelywood was engulfed in flames and sent tumbling violently backward, his armor scorched.
Alloces didn't let up. He somersaulted through the air, spinning with his swords, and continued slashing relentlessly.
His maniacal laughter echoed. "Ho ho ho! Not bad, trash!"
Livelywood's excitement was evident as his body glowed with a vibrant green aura. His sword blazed with the same green energy. Without hesitation, he dashed forward, faster than before!
This time, Livelywood ran with incredible speed, zig-zagging unpredictably. It looked almost like teleportation, though it was simply his unmatched agility and a boost of speed.
Alloces charged once more, and their swords clashed with a thunderous metallic roar. Sparks flew as flames and gusts of wind exploded from their strikes.
Alloces swung his swords with ferocious speed, but Livelywood parried each blow, countering with his own strikes. The clash of their blades created a relentless rhythm of attacks and defenses.
Suddenly, Livelywood leapt back, sidestepped, and spun through the air, skillfully dodging Alloces' next strike. But Alloces raised his blade and parried, sending Livelywood tumbling backward again.
Landing on the ground, Livelywood wasted no time. He lunged forward once more, his strikes and Alloces' counters erupting into another dazzling series of sword clashes.
The fierce battle captivated everyone watching, leaving them amazed.
[NekronsOath]: "Alloces is wild, but why do I feel like he's actually enjoying this too much? 😂"
[MrGibberish]: "Alloces: 'Not bad, trash.' Livelywood: 'Thanks for the compliment, I think?' 🤣"
[DaoistFc80IS]: "If Livelywood survives this, he better write a book titled How to Parry Like a Pro."
[Albertkda4]: "Bro, sorry for playing the same game as you. I'm uninstalling after this. 💀

The battle between Alloces and Livelywood was a display of masterful technique and swordsmanship. Despite their intense clashes, neither side managed to inflict any significant damage. However, every time Livelywood parried, he still took minor damage from Alloces' brutal attacks. Thankfully, Starfall's support allowed him to endure longer.
Alloces flapped his lone wing, propelling himself backward just as Livelywood's blade nearly sliced toward his stomach.
"Ho ho ho!" Alloces laughed.

Livelywood grinned. A fierce green energy swirled around his legs, propelling him into the air as he chased after the demon! He unleashed a flurry of slashes, but Alloces retaliated, sending him flying wildly backward.
Suddenly, Livelywood darted forward again, zig-zagging with incredible speed. He leaped high into the air, and as he rose, his body seemed to split into multiple copies, encircling Alloces midair.
Alloces laughed again, clearly enjoying the challenge. He spun rapidly, slashing in all directions, and within moments, all of Livelywood's illusions vanished.
Out of nowhere, one real Livelywood shot up from below, aiming his blade straight at Alloces' neck!
But Alloces simply grinned. His body suddenly ignited with fiery light, and—clang!—the blade struck with no effect. Livelywood's attack failed to penetrate the demon's defenses.
Alloces countered with both swords, striking Livelywood and sending him hurtling backward.
Livelywood skidded across the ground but managed to steady himself, repositioning his body.
"He's immune to physical damage," Livelywood muttered as he landed, now standing beside Starfall.
"But he can still be hurt by magic damage," Starfall replied. "I've managed to land a few hits, though it's hard from this range."
"Yeah... but if I lose focus for even a second, this fight could turn fatal for me."
Starfall began casting her buffs, and four glowing magic circles spun rapidly behind Livelywood.
"You'll be able to switch between these basic elements and deal magic damage," she explained.
"The damage will be drastically reduced, though, since my physical attacks are useless." Livelywood sighed.
"You only need to hold him off for as long as you can, Livelywood."
"Yeah, I'll do my best," he replied with a cheerful grin, readying himself to attack again.
"Now, it looks like I've become a magic sword fighter, haha," he added with a chuckle.
[Shaun_True]: "Honestly, I don't see this ending anytime soon. Named Demons are built different. Alloces isn't even breaking a sweat. 😭"
[Darrbeast]: "Even if they can't win, Vensalor's effort is legendary. They're giving us a show—total warriors."

chapters.title: Chapter 670: Solarion Prideborn
paragraphs: Northern Gate.
Charmelyn and Skywarden vs Marquis Orias.

Marquis Orias. This demon at first glance doesn't even seem like a demon. Picture this: a creature with the head of a lion, golden-red wings, golden-red armor, a halo floating above its head, and a magical staff in hand. It practically looks more like a celestial warrior than a demon.

But no, this is definitely a Named Demon. Among the four Named Demons currently present, Marquis Orias holds the lowest rank. Even so, its presence is intimidating-especially since it is a magic user and it can fly.
Seriously, why are all the Named Demons that keep appearing either capable of flying or ridiculously massive?
Every encounter has involved aerial opponents or towering giants. Fighting them is beyond exhausting; it's downright infuriating.

The reality is that for players, having the ability to fly is far from common. Only a handful of people can do it naturally, like Elincia, Or Kingsley who can transform into a flying beast. Others, like Livelywood, rely on elemental skills for boosted jumps, or like Goldrich, use hovering platforms, which still demand incredible mana control and mobility.

Then there are those who fly by partnering with their Spirit Beasts, such as Broken with Polly or Booba on his Wyvern. Without any of these options, dealing with airborne foes like Marquis Orias feels like an insurmountable challenge.
[Marquis Orias - Solarion Prideborn Lv. 262]
[Named Demon - Ranking 59]

Charmelyn and Skywarden finally closed the distance to The Demon, though their approach clearly drew skepticism from everyone watching. How in the world could Charmelyn, the assassin, or Skywarden, the tank, possibly stand a chance against Marquis Orias-a flying magic-user hovering well out of reach? Just how?
The two close-range fighters stood ready, preparing for a battle that seemed nearly impossible to win.
Unlike other demons, Marquis Orias wasn't one for excessive talk. He merely spun his magic staff in the air, and moments later, glowing magic circles appeared on the ground below.
From these circles emerged... something truly terrifying.
Spectral lions.

A pack of them. Their bodies looked as if they were formed from ash, with glimmering silver armor covering parts of their forms. Their manes flowed in an elegant motion, as if caught in an unnatural wind. One by one, the lions let out deep, guttural roars, a chilling sound that echoed like a hunt was about to begin.
Charmelyn tightened her grip on her dual daggers, while Skywarden raised his massive shield in front of him.
"A summoner, huh? Figures he's flying up there, keeping himself safe," Skywarden muttered.
Charmelyn nodded slightly, crouching in preparation for a sprint.
"I'll distract the lions. You take down that floating bastard," he said.
"Alright," Charmelyn replied simply.
Charmelyn darted forward in a rapid zigzag motion, moving from one point to another with remarkable speed. Skywarden followed close behind her.
With a powerful stomp of his shield onto the ground, Skywarden summoned an aura of protective energy that floated around the two of them.

The spectral lions began to close in, circling their prey. A few of them lunged, slamming into Skywarden with overwhelming force. He was sent skidding backward across the dirt, but his massive shield held firm, absorbing the brunt of the impact.

Skywarden got back to his feet and sprinted forward, purposefully drawing the attention of the spectral lions. There were ten of them-far too many for one man to handle alone-but he didn't falter. He kept running, occasionally stopping to brace himself against their relentless attacks with his shield.

Meanwhile, Charmelyn took advantage of the chaos. She would appear suddenly from the shadows, striking at one of the lions with her daggers. The spectral beasts howled in pain as her blades cut into them, but before they could retaliate, she vanished again, only to reappear from another direction moments later with another precise attack.
It was a relentless back-and-forth, but the battle had an ominous weight to it. They hadn't even reached the summoner yet, and already it felt like a fight they couldn't possibly win.

All eyes were glued to the battle on the ground, so no one noticed when, suddenly... Charmelyn leapt onto Skywarden's shield. In an instant, a burst of energy erupted, launching her into the air like a missile aimed directly at Marquis Orias!
"Oh, damn!" gasped those watching, their jaws dropping in disbelief.
Could something like this even be done? But wait-Charmelyn was just an assassin.
What could she possibly do in the air?
Surely, she'd just plummet back down after this reckless stunt!
As Charmelyn soared through the sky, she swung both of her hands with force. In a flash, another Charmelyn materialized mid-air, hurtling forward while the original Charmelyn vanished.
"What the hell?!" someone muttered.
Marquis Orias, realizing the threat, darted higher into the air.

Then, without warning, there were dozens of her. No, hundreds. The sky filled with countless Charmelyns, all darting toward the demon in an overwhelming barrage. They struck one after the other, slashing at Marquis Orias with deadly efficiency.

Blow after blow landed, but the demon's magic shield flared to life, deflecting most of the attacks. Growling in frustration, Marquis Orias flapped his wings furiously, pushing himself farther away, retreating beyond Charmelyn's reach.
One of Charmelyn's copies sprinted forward and leapt over the others, propelling itself toward Marquis Orias with breakneck speed. In that instant, all her remaining copies vanished.
She conjured a fresh wave of clones, each one diving toward the demon in unison, raining down a relentless barrage of slashes and strikes.
The assault was intense, but the copies couldn't withstand Orias's counterattacks. One by one, they shattered and dissolved into nothingness, leaving Charmelyn exposed.
Her balance broke, and she began to tumble uncontrollably toward the ground.

From below, Skywarden surged forward, shouldering his way through the pack of spectral lions. Reaching her just in time, he raised his massive shield, intercepting her fall and bracing her against its sturdy surface.
Charmelyn took a deep breath, her body steadying as she regained composure amidst the storm of battle.
"Ready?" Skywarden grunted.
Without waiting for an answer, another massive surge of energy erupted from his shield. The force launched Charmelyn skyward with astonishing speed.

Twisting midair, she unleashed her signature acrobatics, flipping gracefully and summoning another wave of clones to propel herself forward. With precision, she hurtled toward Marquis Orias once more, her clones forming a dazzling formation around her as she closed the distance with the relentless demon.
It was nothing short of an insane performance, leaving everyone watching in awe. But this strategy wasn't sustainable.

As Charmelyn continued her relentless assaults in the air, the situation on the ground began to deteriorate. Skywarden, now overwhelmed, was struggling against the onslaught of spectral lions. The summoned beasts closed in, their sheer numbers and aggression making it nearly impossible for him to move freely.

The dilemma was clear: they needed to take out the spectral summons first. But doing so was pointless-Marquis Orias would simply call forth another wave. The real target was the demon himself, but he remained safely airborne, out of their reach.

They couldn't keep this up much longer. The fight was turning into a vicious cycle, and one thing was obvious: they needed stronger players who could fight in the air. Without that, this battle was a losing game.

[EvilNCarnate]: "Marquis Orias probably thinking, 'How many of her are there?!" ["

carrying this fight!"
[Darkstrider]: "Skywarden deserves a medal for that save. Someone get this man a coffee!"

It was nothing short of an insane performance, leaving everyone watching in awe.
But this strategy wasn't sustainable.
As Charmelyn continued her relentless assaults in the air, the situation on the ground began to deteriorate.
Skywarden, now overwhelmed, was struggling against the onslaught of spectral lions.
The summoned beasts closed in, their sheer numbers and aggression making it nearly impossible for him to move freely.
The dilemma was clear: they needed to take out the spectral summons first.
But doing so was pointless-Marquis Orias would simply call forth another wave.
The real target was the demon himself, but he remained safely airborne, out of their reach.
They couldn't keep this up much longer.
The fight was turning into a vicious cycle, and one thing was obvious: they needed stronger players who could fight in the air.
Without that, this battle was a losing game.

chapters.title: Chapter 671: The King’s Missing Command (Full-Length)
paragraphs: The battle across the gates of the Capital of Dissidia Kingdom raged on, and hope for a brighter outcome seemed increasingly distant.

Even as more players arrived to bolster the fight and the Knights spread out to reinforce the frontlines, the sheer numbers of demons were overwhelming. From the fortress walls, troops unleashed powerful ranged attacks, yet it wasn't enough to stem the unrelenting tide of enemies.

Only players whose levels approached or exceeded 200 dared to push deeper into the chaos, where the monsters' strength climbed to terrifying heights. At the forefront were the Vensalor Guild members, locked in direct combat with the Named Demons-an impossible task for most.

At the Western Gate, Optimus fought relentlessly, embodying the perfect balance of speed and strength. He zipped across the battlefield like lightning, delivering punishing blows to any demon that dared to stand in his way. Yet, despite his brutal assault, his strikes barely seemed to scratch the immense defense of his foe, King Balam.

The bull-headed demon, wielding a massive flaming greatsword, stood as an immovable force. His area attacks devastated swathes of players and knights alike, forcing Optimus to constantly dodge while chipping away at the behemoth. But Optimus alone was not enough.

At the Eastern Gate, Goldrich and Jovina were also locked in a fierce struggle. Despite their incredible teamwork and Goldrich's massive Abyss Devourer summon, they couldn't bring down Countess Murmur.

The demoness, with her elegant wings and masterful control of the skies, skillfully evaded the Abyss Devourer's devastating attacks. Her mobility was unmatched, and she used it to her advantage, striking from unexpected angles and keeping her challengers on the defensive.

With each passing moment, the battle across the capital's gates grew more desperate, and the demons seemed unstoppable. The Named Demons stood as unyielding titans, turning even the most valiant efforts into a grueling fight for survival.
"Tora, now tell me," Max said, her eyes fixed on the battlefield screens as she closely monitored the progress. "What's your analysis of the situation at the Western and Eastern Gates?"

"The facts are grim, Max. At the Western Gate, Optimus is struggling to deliver enough damage to pose a real threat to King Balam. That demon's Constitution, Health, and Defense are ridiculously high. Optimus has to constantly balance attacking with avoiding fatal blows -because one serious hit could take him out of the fight entirely."
Max nodded, her expression hardening. "That's a tough pill to swallow, Tora."

Tora continued, his gaze shifting to another screen. "Meanwhile, at the Eastern Gate, the main issue is Countess Murmur's mobility. She's using it masterfully to outmaneuver her opponents. Goldrich has been doing his best to keep up, but without any natural flying abilities like Elincia's, he's at a significant disadvantage. As for Jovina, even with her aerial summons, only two of them can actually engage Murmur in the air, and they're still not able to deal enough damage to make a difference."
Max rubbed her chin thoughtfully. "So both sides are facing walls they can't seem to break through. The longer this goes on, the worse it'll get."
"Exactly," Tora replied. "And these Named Demons aren't just walls-they're towers, designed to wear you down until there's nothing left."

At the Eastern Gate, Livelywood and Starfall faced challenges strikingly similar to the other fronts. Duke Alloces, their opponent, was a swordmaster with incredible speed and strength -a perfect matchup against someone like Livelywood, who also relied on physical prowess and swordsmanship.

However, Duke Alloces possessed a significant advantage: the ability to render himself immune to physical attacks for brief but critical moments. This rendered many of Livelywood's strikes ineffective, frustrating the swordsman's attempts to gain the upper hand.

Starfall, meanwhile, struggled to provide meaningful support. As a versatile mage, her skills leaned more toward crowd control and utility rather than pure offensive magic, limiting her ability to tip the scales in their favor.

At the Northern Gate, Charmelyn and Skywarden faced a similarly grueling battle against Marquis Orias. The flying demon utilized his aerial dominance to harass them relentlessly. His spectral lion summons added even more chaos, forcing Skywarden to split his focus between defending himself from the lions and maintaining his ground against Orias's ranged attacks.

"But Max," Tora said as he analyzed the situation, "if I may be blunt, a single Named Demon should ideally be confronted by a much larger team. Trying to handle them with just a few players is practically suicidal."
Max frowned but countered, "But Tora, there are so many players on the battlefield. Can't they all converge on the Named Demons and overwhelm them with sheer numbers?"
Tora shook his head. "First, most of those players are focused on defending the city walls from the demon horde. If they leave their posts, the walls will collapse, and the capital will be overrun."

He paused before adding, "Second, many of those players aren't at a high enough level to handle a Named Demon. Sending them in would be pointless-they'd be slaughtered in seconds, and all they'd accomplish is adding more chaos to the fight."
"So, it's a deadlock. Every front is stuck against opponents they can't handle, and reinforcements can't make it to them without jeopardizing the city's defenses."
Tora and Max kept their eyes glued to the various screens, monitoring the intense battles at each gate.
The chatter from viewers watching the live broadcast filled the air, their comments drenched in despair.
"It's over!"
"Dissidia Capital is doomed!"
"There's no way they can hold out any longer!"

This was the first time many had seen the terrifying power of Named Demons-even those ranked in the 50s were proving nearly invincible. The sheer destructive potential of these monsters was undeniable. It became abundantly clear why higher-ranked Named Demons were said to be capable of obliterating entire cities with ease.

At the Western Gate, Optimus began to show signs of exhaustion. His resources were nearly depleted, and Toberry and Trison were barely holding on themselves, overwhelmed by the relentless swarm of demons.
Then...
It happened!
A massive object shot across the battlefield like a blur, spinning violently.
It collided with King Balam's face with such devastating force that the demon staggered backward, his massive greatsword missing Optimus by mere inches.
The shockwave of the impact silenced the battlefield momentarily, and Max and Tora sat up straight, their attention locked onto the screen.
"Tora! Are you thinking what I'm thinking?!" Max exclaimed.
"Yes, Max. Yes! They've arrived!"

Suddenly, a figure descended in front of King Balam, cutting through the chaos with an imposing presence. A woman with blonde hair, clad in gleaming heavy armor, appeared. Without hesitation, she launched herself toward the massive demon, her shield in hand. With relentless force, she began hammering blow after blow into King Balam's massive frame.
"Ivana has arrived, Max!" Tora exclaimed.
"Ivana! Our Shield Maiden!"
They quickly shifted their focus to the Eastern Gate, where Goldrich and Jovina were still struggling to catch up to Countess Murmur.

But before they could act, the demoness was suddenly bombarded by a series of precise, devastating shots from an unexpected angle. The force of the attacks threw Countess Murmur off balance, her movements in the air growing erratic.
High above the fortress walls, a figure stood with her sniper rifle aimed directly at the demoness.
"Melliandra!" Max gasped.
"She's arrived too!" Tora confirmed.
At the Northern Gate, where Charmelyn and Skywarden were desperately battling Marquis
Orias, a shadow suddenly swept across the sky.
Out of nowhere, a massive hawk-like creature descended with monstrous force, colliding directly with Orias. The impact sent the demon staggering back.
"Kingsley in his beast form!" Max exclaimed.
"Kingsley and Melliandra are here!" Tora added.
But Max squinted at the creature in the air. "Wait, Tora, why does this feel like the first time
I'm seeing Kingsley in this form?"

"Because it is, Max. This is his new form-The Armored Sky Sovereign." Kingsley's hawk form wasn't just avian-it had humanoid elements. Its massive wings were reinforced with gleaming, armored plates, and its sleek body was encased in dark, enchanted armor.
"What is that?!" Max gasped.
Tora's grin widened. "It's Kingsley's new form-upgraded from his new class. They call this evolution 'The Armored Sky Sovereign."
"An upgraded class?!" Max's eyes lit up. "I can't wait to see how he demonstrates this power!"
"You will, Max," Tora said, though his tone quickly turned serious. "But we should also check on the Southern Gate. Things could be just as critical there."
Max nodded, already switching her focus to the next screen. "Let's go. The fight isn't over yet."
[Melliandra - Epic Void Sharpshooter]
[Kingsley - Epic Primal Beastmaster]
Both Melliandra and Kingsley had also acquired Epic-grade classes, solidifying their status as formidable forces on the battlefield.
At the Southern Gate!
Elincia hovered in the air, her form glowing faintly as she continuously cast magic attacks, hurling bolts of energy down at their target-Duke Alloces.

The demon roared in frustration, repeatedly attempting to close the distance and strike her, but Livelywood worked tirelessly to keep him grounded. The swordsman darted around the battlefield, using precise strikes and sheer determination to force the Duke to stay focused on him.
The tide of battle seemed to shift. Hope glimmered on the horizon, as their combined efforts finally began to show results.
Yet, despite this progress, a lingering question weighed heavily on everyone's minds.
Where was the King?
And more importantly, where were his Imperial Knights?
These were the forces the kingdom relied on in times of crisis, and their absence in the face of such overwhelming demon forces was both troubling and mystifying.

For now, everyone fought on, holding the line with everything they had. But the unanswered question loomed like a shadow over the battlefield, threatening to overshadow even the small victories they were clawing out.
When even victory itself could not be guaranteed. Would this truly be the end of Dissidia Kingdom?

chapters.title: Chapter 672: Alloces’ Wrath
paragraphs: Reinforcements have arrived!
Hope surged across the battlefield.

Each of the four gates had now received powerful new additions to their forces, turning the tides of despair into a glimmer of optimism. With these reinforcements, the battles at the gates were poised to shift dramatically.

On the ground and through the live broadcasts, the tension was so high. Those on the battlefield fought with renewed vigor, while spectators clung to the edges of their seats, eager to witness the pivotal moments that could finally break the stalemate.
Would this be the turning point everyone had been waiting for?
Western Gate.
Ivana unleashed devastating damage, amplifying the momentum created by Optimus and the others at the Western Gate.

Time and again, she hurled her shield toward King Balam, striking the demon's face with bone-crushing force. Each time, she followed through by teleporting to her shield, delivering colossal blows that sent shockwaves rippling across the battlefield.
DOOM! The impact shook the ground, scattering debris and forcing the nearby demons to reel from the sheer force.

With Ivana's shield plays providing cover, Optimus felt a newfound freedom in his movements. He zigzagged rapidly, avoiding the massive swings of King Balam's greatsword. Exploiting every opening, he dashed in with remarkable speed, delivering punishing strikes to the demon's legs. These precise attacks destabilized the hulking demon, pushing him back step by step.

King Balam retaliated with a blast of fire, targeting Ivana as she soared through the air. But with practiced ease, she threw her shield high into the sky, vanishing in an instant and reappearing above it. From above, she dived with blistering speed, her shield leading the charge.
D-D-DOOM!!!
The impact was devastating, the shockwave spreading outward in all directions.
The relentless combination of Optimus's precision and Ivana's force was beginning to tilt the scales, giving the defenders a crucial edge.

"Tora, tell me something..." Max asked, her tone brimming with enthusiasm. "Isn't Ivana a shielder? I mean, I've never seen a shield user deal this much damage before. Her main weapon is a shield, right?"

Tora gave an awkward grin. "Oh, Max, I think you're forgetting about all those famous fictional characters who use shields as their main offensive weapon. Ivana just happens to be one of them in this world."

"Okay, I get it," Max replied with a small laugh. "But still, I'm impressed-and honestly, I'm grateful she's here. Though, one thing I noticed... she hasn't cast that massive protective skill she used during the Deadbay Battle. Why is that?

"That's likely tied to her resources, Max." Tora's tone turned analytical. "Mana, Stamina, and the situations she's facing right now. If Ivana shifted her focus to full-on defense, protecting others, the team might not have enough damage output to make meaningful progress against King Balam."
Max nodded thoughtfully. "That makes sense. With both Optimus and Ivana focusing on offense, things at the Western Gate are looking much better. Let's keep watching. I want to see how this develops."
Eastern Gate.

Goldrich and Jovina had also received critical reinforcement in the form of Melliandra, whose newly upgraded Epic-grade class brought devastating long-range firepower to their fight against Countess Murmur.
The sharpshooter stood at a distance atop a fortress, surrounded by a mix of knights and long-range players.
Perched on a transparent platform, she peered through the scope of her sniper rifle. Each time her rifle fired, the recoil sent her sliding slightly, but she kept her aim steady.
"Elincia!" Melliandra called over the guild conference. "Why didn't you drag that blacksmith over here? He took down that bitch Akiko in one hit! His level must be insanely high."
Elincia's tone was measured. "I'm not the right person to answer that question." "Ch! Useless!" Melliandra spat.

"Goldrich!!!" she suddenly screamed. "That bitch is heading my way! HOLD HER OFF!" Goldrich, in the distance, sprinted across a series of transparent platforms, casting a barrage of magic missiles to halt Countess Murmur's advance. As the demoness roared and charged forward, Goldrich abruptly leapt into her path, raising his staff high.
"Abyss Devourer!" Goldrich bellowed.

Behind him, a massive dark portal tore open, revealing the grotesque maw of an enormous shadowy creature, its glowing green mouth lined with jagged teeth. Then, it released a cannon-like blast that engulfed Countess Murmur entirely.
"ARGHHH!" The demoness screamed in fury as her burning form was flung backward, flames of green fire licking at her body.
"HOW DARE YOU!" she shrieked. Her wings spread wide as she surged forward, her staff glowing, retaliating with a devastating strike aimed directly at Goldrich.

However, just as the demoness prepared to launch herself forward again, something strange happened around her wings. They suddenly twisted as if being sucked into an invisible vortex. Moments later, a massive explosion erupted, blasting the demon violently in one direction.
"Nice one, Melliandra," Goldrich said with a smirk.
He twirled his magic staff effortlessly, and in an instant, a massive magic circle appeared in the air, glowing with power and ready to unleash another devastating barrage of magic.
Southern Gate.

On another front, Livelywood now had the support of two skilled mages: Starfall, with her versatility in crowd control, buffs, and healing, and Elincia, who hovered nearby, raining down massive magic damage on Duke Alloces from above.
With a bright grin, Livelywood darted across the battlefield, moving at incredible speed. He relentlessly pressured the demon, especially when Alloces tried to launch aerial strikes against Elincia.

Rumbling lightning strikes repeatedly crashed down onto the battlefield, each impact illuminating the skirmish with bursts of electric fury. The clashes between Duke Alloces and Livelywood painted a chaotic dance of fire and steel.
The demon moved with inhuman agility, flipping and dashing through the fray. He wielded his twin swords with precision, evading every magic strike with ease.
"Ho ho ho! Interesting!" Alloces taunted. "Do you think that cute little magic damage is enough to scratch my skin? No!"

Livelywood zipped forward, appearing directly in front of the demon with startling speed. Their blades clashed in a dazzling flurry. Suddenly, Alloces spewed a jet of fire, forcing Livelywood to somersault backward to avoid being engulfed.
"Mr. Demon!" Livelywood called out cheerfully. "Don't forget, if you're late blocking my attack, I'll be the first to scratch your skin! That'll be a big achievement for me!"
Alloces snarled, clearly unimpressed, as the battlefield raged around them.

However, as the battle wore on, Duke Alloces' movements grew faster, more unpredictable, and increasingly difficult for Livelywood to counter effectively. Despite his best efforts, Alloces evaded every strike.

From another angle, a barrage of massive boulders, chunks of ice, and a surge of waves assaulted the demon, briefly disrupting his rhythm. But with a sharp flap of his left wing, Duke Alloces redirected his focus, launching himself toward Elincia.

Elincia quickly conjured a massive shield, its surface crackling with defensive magic. The demon's attack struck with devastating force, shattering through her defenses and sending her plummeting toward the ground.
"Elincia!" Starfall screamed, sprinting to intercept her falling ally, but she wasn't fast enough. Elincia crashed into the earth with a resounding thud.
Livelywood dashed, trying to reach her first, but Alloces was faster. He descended with precision, landing in front of Elincia as she struggled to recover.
Duke Alloces brought his swords close to her neck. "Ho ho ho... your friend meets her end now!"

Each time her rifle fired, the recoil sent her sliding slightly, but she kept her aim steady.
"Elincia!" Melliandra called over the guild conference.
"Why didn't you drag that blacksmith over here?
He took down that bitch Akiko in one hit!
His level must be insanely high."
Elincia's tone was measured.
"I'm not the right person to answer that question." "Ch!
Useless!" Melliandra spat.
"Goldrich!!!" she suddenly screamed.
"That bitch is heading my way!
HOLD HER OFF!" Goldrich, in the distance, sprinted across a series of transparent platforms, casting a barrage of magic missiles to halt Countess Murmur's advance.
As the demoness roared and charged forward, Goldrich abruptly leapt into her path, raising his staff high.
"Abyss Devourer!" Goldrich bellowed.
Behind him, a massive dark portal tore open, revealing the grotesque maw of an enormous shadowy creature, its glowing green mouth lined with jagged teeth.
Then, it released a cannon-like blast that engulfed Countess Murmur entirely.
"ARGHHH!" The demoness screamed in fury as her burning form was flung backward, flames of green fire licking at her body.
"HOW DARE YOU!" she shrieked.
Her wings spread wide as she surged forward, her staff glowing, retaliating with a devastating strike aimed directly at Goldrich.
However, just as the demoness prepared to launch herself forward again, something strange happened around her wings.
They suddenly twisted as if being sucked into an invisible vortex.
Moments later, a massive explosion erupted, blasting the demon violently in one direction.
"Nice one, Melliandra," Goldrich said with a smirk.
He twirled his magic staff effortlessly, and in an instant, a massive magic circle appeared in the air, glowing with power and ready to unleash another devastating barrage of magic.
Southern Gate.

On another front, Livelywood now had the support of two skilled mages: Starfall, with her versatility in crowd control, buffs, and healing, and Elincia, who hovered nearby, raining down massive magic damage on Duke Alloces from above.
With a bright grin, Livelywood darted across the battlefield, moving at incredible speed.
He relentlessly pressured the demon, especially when Alloces tried to launch aerial strikes against Elincia.
Rumbling lightning strikes repeatedly crashed down onto the battlefield, each impact illuminating the skirmish with bursts of electric fury.
The clashes between Duke Alloces and Livelywood painted a chaotic dance of fire and steel.
The demon moved with inhuman agility, flipping and dashing through the fray.
He wielded his twin swords with precision, evading every magic strike with ease.
"Ho ho ho!
Interesting!" Alloces taunted.
"Do you think that cute little magic damage is enough to scratch my skin?
No!"
Livelywood zipped forward, appearing directly in front of the demon with startling speed.
Their blades clashed in a dazzling flurry.
Suddenly, Alloces spewed a jet of fire, forcing Livelywood to somersault backward to avoid being engulfed.
"Mr.
Demon!" Livelywood called out cheerfully.
"Don't forget, if you're late blocking my attack, I'll be the first to scratch your skin!
That'll be a big achievement for me!"
Alloces snarled, clearly unimpressed, as the battlefield raged around them.
However, as the battle wore on, Duke Alloces' movements grew faster, more unpredictable, and increasingly difficult for Livelywood to counter effectively.
Despite his best efforts, Alloces evaded every strike.
From another angle, a barrage of massive boulders, chunks of ice, and a surge of waves assaulted the demon, briefly disrupting his rhythm.
But with a sharp flap of his left wing, Duke Alloces redirected his focus, launching himself toward Elincia.
Elincia quickly conjured a massive shield, its surface crackling with defensive magic.
The demon's attack struck with devastating force, shattering through her defenses and sending her plummeting toward the ground.
"Elincia!" Starfall screamed, sprinting to intercept her falling ally, but she wasn't fast enough.
Elincia crashed into the earth with a resounding thud.
Livelywood dashed, trying to reach her first, but Alloces was faster.
He descended with precision, landing in front of Elincia as she struggled to recover.
Duke Alloces brought his swords close to her neck.
"Ho ho ho... your friend meets her end now!"

chapters.title: Chapter 673: Fatherhood or Glory?
paragraphs: The café door creaked open, letting in a gust of cold air carrying traces of snow from outside. Inside, the usually tranquil atmosphere was anything but. Patrons clustered around a large screen dominating one wall, their faces tense as they watched what seemed to be a massive, vividly animated war unfolding.
The one who had entered was a man clad in a thick coat, his blonde hair tousled by the icy wind. Beside him was a little girl, no older than five, her small hand tightly clasped in his.
"I'm so hungry. I want to eat," the girl said.
The man hesitated, glancing at the crowd. He gently pulled her hand, leaning down slightly. "Are you sure you want to eat here? What about finding another place?"
"No, Daddy," the girl replied. "You promised we'd eat here this morning."
"Okay." With a soft sigh, he relented, guiding her toward the farthest table, tucked away from the crowd.
He helped her out of her school bag, placing it on a chair before she pulled out a book and began to flip through it. Her legs swung idly beneath the table as she read.
For a moment, her eyes wandered back to the screen and the captivated patrons.
"Daddy..." she began.
"Yes, May?"
"I haven't seen you play that game in a long time," she said, pointing toward the screen. "Don't you miss it?"
The man's lips curved into a faint smile as he shook his head. "I'm a bit busy now, and..." He paused, his gaze softening as he looked at her. "I want to spend more time with you."
The little girl nodded, her curiosity piqued as sudden shouts erupted from the crowd.
"No, no, no! Someone needs to save Charmelyn!"
"Oh, damn it! She's an assassin, for god's sake! How is she supposed to fight a flying demon like that?!"
"This is so depressing. Someone has to step in already."
"Where are the other Vensalor members?
"Yeah, Elincia, Kingsley-even Broken! Where the hell are they?"
"Goldrich and Jovina are struggling on their side too."
"But, all the credit has to go to this rich old man. He's truly the GOAT!"
May tilted her head, her curious eyes darting between the commotion and her father.
"Daddy, are they talking about your friends?" she asked

But her father didn't respond. He remained frozen, his gaze locked on the large screen at the far end of the room. His hand, still gripping the pitcher he'd been using to pour her water, trembled slightly as the liquid overflowed, spilling across the table in a silent cascade.
Noticing his expression, May furrowed her brow. She quickly leaned forward, steadying the pitcher and nudging it upright before gently pushing his hand away.
"Daddy! You're making a mess!"
Her words jolted him out of his daze. "Ah, sorry. I didn't mean to..." He chuckled, grabbing a napkin to mop up the spill.
May giggled softly. "You're so silly, Daddy."
A short while later, the man and his daughter finished their meal. He helped her bundle up in her coat and scarf before gently taking her hand and leading her out of the café in a hurry.
As they made their way to the exit, several patrons exchanged glances, some leaning close to whisper in hushed tones.
"Are you sure? No way!"
"Yes, I'm positive! That's him. Maylock! I'd recognize him anywhere."
"No way! If he'd been in the game, the battle wouldn't have been half as hard!"
"Oh, man. I really want to go up to him and say something."
"I heard he's dealing with personal stuff. That's why he hasn't logged into the game lately.
"He has to know what's happening. He must."
"Should I go over? Just to tell him how much he's inspired all of us in Immortal Legacy?"
"He probably has his reasons. It's not for us to question."
Northern Gate.
Charmelyn, Skywarden, and Kingsley vs Marquis Orias.

Something extraordinary dominated the battlefield. A colossal grizzly bear, monstrous in size, stood clad in jagged black armor streaked with glowing gold accents. The armor was, featuring spiked pauldrons and a heavily reinforced chest plate.

From afar, the grizzly was truly a breathtaking spectacle. The sheer size and weight of its armor made it even more formidable. Its massive frame smashed through the battlefield, striking wildly while spectral lions lunged at it from various directions, trying to overwhelm it.
"Let's call this beast Dawnbreaker, Max," Tora remarked, keeping an eye on the clash raging across the four gates.

"That name is seriously cool, Tora," Max replied. "The armor looks insanely solid, and it makes Kingsley's transformation even more terrifying! But... does his new class allow him to equip armor like that?"

"Haha, well, that's a simple way of putting it. Yes, it's one of the perks," Tora admitted with a grin. "But there's definitely more to it. I think Kingsley hasn't revealed everything about his abilities just yet."
"Still," Max continued, "Kingsley's transformation is incredibly versatile. He can focus on brute damage or even take to the skies. I'd say Charmelyn just got a massive boost in this fight."

The battle with the current team raged on for what felt like an eternity. Every player poured their hopes into this massive fight, pushing their limits to turn the tide. Yet, on another front, the number of demons remained overwhelming, and despite their best efforts, many players found themselves unable to hold the line, with some succumbing to defeat.
Western Gate.

The situation worsened when members of the Vensalor Guild began to falter. Ivana and Optimus were both caught in the crushing grasp of King Balam's massive hands. A torrent of blazing fire engulfed them, yet Ivana's protective shield held firm, sparing them for now- but it was clear the shield wouldn't last forever.
"Trison! We need to save them!" Toberry shouted. "If we don't do something, they'll die! Ivana... we can't let her fall!"
"Toberry, do you seriously think we can get close?" Trison shot back. "The demons are endless! We can barely hold this position as it is."
"No way! We can't let anything happen to Ivana!"

chapters.title: Chapter 674: Dominant Surge
paragraphs: Eastern Gate.

And then there was Melliandra. Countess Murmur had broken free of containment and was charging straight for the fortress. Chaos trailed in her wake, leaving the players stationed there helpless to stop her advance. One by one, they fell, unable to withstand her devastating assault.

Melliandra sprinted across a series of floating, translucent platforms, desperately dodging a relentless barrage of magic missiles raining down on her. Her face was etched with frustration and despair.
"Damn it, this bitch! Goldrich! Jovina! Do something!" she shouted.
Northern Gate.
Kingsley, meanwhile, was under relentless assault, barely managing to hold his ground. Charmelyn wasn't in much better shape, overwhelmed by the unending swarm of summons unleashed by Marquis Orias.

Forced to stay grounded, Kingsley found himself struggling against a pack of spectral lions that relentlessly attacked him, Charmelyn, and Skywarden. The trio could do little more than defend each other. They were becoming increasingly powerless, unable to mount any kind of meaningful offense against the Demon.
The team was stretched to its absolute limit, and with every moment, the battle's outcome grew more uncertain.
Southern Gate.
Meanwhile, on another part of the battlefield, Elincia lay pinned to the ground, two swords crossed at her throat. Towering over her was Duke Alloces, his cruel grin promising her demise.
Livelywood stood nearby, frozen by the Duke's chilling threat—any attempt to intervene would lead to Elincia's immediate execution.
"Livelywood, do something! Attack this demon!"
"Ho ho ho... such desperate cries," Alloces sneered. "I quite enjoy them."
Elincia was moments away from being taken out of the fight entirely. Without her, this battle would only become harder for the team to win.
Then, out of nowhere...

A figure shot toward Duke Alloces, moving so fast that the Demon couldn't react in time. The impact was sending Alloces flying across the battlefield. He crashed to the ground, staggering to his feet with an enraged snarl, his eyes scanning for the one who dared to strike him.
Standing calmly amidst the chaos was a man clad in heavy black armor, his dark hair catching the flickering light of the battlefield.
"Hah! Looks like I got here just in time!" the man declared.
Elincia's eyes widened in shock as she recognized him.
"Booba! What are you doing here?" she exclaimed, scrambling to her feet.
Livelywood and Starfall hurried closer.
"Booba, I don't think this is the place for you," Livelywood said cautiously. "The demons here... their levels are way too high."
Booba glanced at Livelywood, a cocky grin spreading across his face. Without a word, he tapped into the guild conference channel.
"Hey, everyone in the guild! Listen to me!" he called out as he began walking toward Duke Alloces.
"Booba, you asshole! What crazy stunt are you pulling now? Stop making this war harder than it already is!" Melliandra snapped.
"Khi khi khi... so, you finally decided to show up, Booba," Goldrich chuckled.
"You know," Booba began. "I was the first person in this guild to recognize Broken. The first to ever call him a friend. All of you? You're second to me."
"Nobody cares! You're useless, just dead weight!" Melliandra shot back.
Booba smirked. "Well, today!" he declared, "I'm announcing to everyone that I'm the third person in this guild to have become..."
"What?!"

But before anyone could respond further, Booba launched himself toward Duke Alloces with blinding speed. In a flash, his blade clashed with the Demon Duke's, sending Alloces hurtling backward with such force that even Livelywood, who had struggled against him, stared in astonishment.
"Whoa... Booba!" Livelywood exclaimed.
Booba didn't slow down, his voice ringing out across the battlefield.

"Dominant Surge!" he declared. "That's the blessing I received from my Divine Champion of Wrath. And now..." he grinned confidently, gripping his sword tighter, "let's see if this Demon Duke can keep up!"
"What the fuck?!" Nearly everyone reacted in shock.
"Divine Champion of Wrath?!"
"How the hell?!" another exclaimed.

Booba continued, "This Blessing allows me to gain extra stat points depending on how many enemies are surrounding me! Plus, it boosts my stats by up to 50% if I'm up against opponents with a level difference of up to 100."
"Damn, that's broken!" Melliandra exclaimed.
"Oh, come on now. Name one Divine Champion Blessing that isn't broken?"
Western Gate.

Ivana and Optimus were trapped in the crushing grip of King Balam, the demon's massive hands holding them firmly as flames gathered around his body. In a terrifying display of power, he unleashed a fiery blast directly at the two. Their protective shield shimmered, straining under the heat, visibly thinning with every passing second.

Nearby, Toberry and Trison were desperately evading the relentless swarm of demons closing in around them. They fought to stay on their feet, darting and blocking as best they could, but the horde was overwhelming. Other players nearby were falling one by one, unable to withstand the onslaught.
Until-
Out of nowhere, a spinning object tore through the chaos. It whirled past Toberry and Trison, the sheer force of its rotation striking down the demons around them.
The spinning projectile flew with precision and slammed directly into King Balam with a deafening D-D-D-DOOM!
The impact sent the massive demon staggering backward, loosening his grip and dropping Ivana and Optimus. Freed at last, the pair quickly repositioned themselves, retreating to safety.
From a distance, a figure came sprinting across the battlefield, smashing through anything in his way. As he neared Ivana and Optimus, his pace slowed, and his steps became deliberate.
Ivana turned toward the figure, her eyes glistening with emotion. "Mr. Fokil..." she whispered.
The dwarf gave a small, knowing smile. "What a mess," he said.
Optimus bowed slightly. "Optimus, member of Vensalor Guild, greets you."
Fokil strode past them without pause.
"Where is Broken? He promised to protect Ivana, and yet he's not here. Hah!"
With a slight huff, he raised his right hand, summoning his hammer back into his grasp as it spun through the air toward him. He caught it effortlessly with his iron grip.
"Let's deal with this rude visitor," he said, his tone low and resolute.
Eastern Gate.

Just before Melliandra could be overwhelmed by the barrage of magic missiles that might have been fatal, something moved swiftly from the direction of the fortress. The force slammed into Countess Murmur, causing her to lose her balance and crash to the ground.
Seizing the moment, Goldrich quickly advanced and cast his cage skill, trapping the demoness in a shimmering magical prison.
The figure that had delivered the blow descended to the battlefield, revealing itself to be a massive wolf cloaked in shadows, with crackling flames dancing along its body.

Jovina approached, a grin spreading across her face. "Thanks, Fang. Hahaha." "Dammit, Jovina!" Melliandra snapped, still catching her breath. "Why did you wait so long to summon Fang? You nearly got me killed!"
"Hah!" Jovina retorted with a smirk. "Did you think Fang is some kind of winged wolf? There's no point summoning him if he can't attack effectively yet. Now shut up and do your job!"
Northern Gate.
Charmelyn continued her relentless assault on Marquis Orias in the air, supported by

Kingsley, who worked tirelessly to divert the demon's attention. Riding atop Kingsley hawk form, Charmelyn cast an array of clones to repeatedly strike at the demon, each attack aiming to wear him down.

But Marquis Orias moved with startling speed this time. A sudden surge of magic lashed out at Kingsley, hitting his hawk form and sending him spiraling to the ground. Charmelyn, caught off guard, lost her footing and plummeted, while Skywarden struggled to fend off the onslaught from below.
Until...
A figure shot in from the distance, catching Charmelyn from behind and holding her steady in the air.
As Charmelyn floated in their grasp, another figure appeared before her, descending gracefully. Five gleaming swords hovered in a perfect orbit around the newcomer.
The woman with wavy blonde hair turned her head. "Hi, I saved you... so this means I'm better than you, doesn't it?" she said, chuckling softly.
The person holding Charmelyn sighed heavily. "Grill, this isn't the time for rivalry."
Still shaken from her near fall, Charmelyn stammered, "SexyGrill, Sexy-" "No!" the short-haired blonde interrupted, cutting her off. "Just Bloom. Only Bloom, okay?"
"Yes, sorry. Thanks, Grill, Bloom," Charmelyn muttered quickly.
SexyGrill took the lead. "Now, let me and Bloom handle the aerial battle. You and the others focus on their summons on the ground."
"Okay, got it," Charmelyn replied. As SexyBloom released her, she landed smoothly on the battlefield, immediately preparing to rejoin the fight below.

Turning toward Bloom, SexyGrill added with a mischievous chuckle, "We only have a little time, so let's take this demon out-and I'll be sure to take all the credit in front of Broken." "Save your confidence for after we've actually won," Bloom retorted.

"Optimus, member of Vensalor Guild, greets you."
Fokil strode past them without pause.
"Where is Broken?
He promised to protect Ivana, and yet he's not here.
Hah!"
With a slight huff, he raised his right hand, summoning his hammer back into his grasp as it spun through the air toward him.
He caught it effortlessly with his iron grip.
"Let's deal with this rude visitor," he said, his tone low and resolute.
Eastern Gate.
Just before Melliandra could be overwhelmed by the barrage of magic missiles that might have been fatal, something moved swiftly from the direction of the fortress.
The force slammed into Countess Murmur, causing her to lose her balance and crash to the ground.
Seizing the moment, Goldrich quickly advanced and cast his cage skill, trapping the demoness in a shimmering magical prison.
The figure that had delivered the blow descended to the battlefield, revealing itself to be a massive wolf cloaked in shadows, with crackling flames dancing along its body.
Jovina approached, a grin spreading across her face.
"Thanks, Fang.
Hahaha." "Dammit, Jovina!" Melliandra snapped, still catching her breath.
"Why did you wait so long to summon Fang?
You nearly got me killed!"
"Hah!" Jovina retorted with a smirk.
"Did you think Fang is some kind of winged wolf?
There's no point summoning him if he can't attack effectively yet.
Now shut up and do your job!"
Northern Gate.
Charmelyn continued her relentless assault on Marquis Orias in the air, supported by
Kingsley, who worked tirelessly to divert the demon's attention.
Riding atop Kingsley hawk form, Charmelyn cast an array of clones to repeatedly strike at the demon, each attack aiming to wear him down.
But Marquis Orias moved with startling speed this time.
A sudden surge of magic lashed out at Kingsley, hitting his hawk form and sending him spiraling to the ground.
Charmelyn, caught off guard, lost her footing and plummeted, while Skywarden struggled to fend off the onslaught from below.
Until...
A figure shot in from the distance, catching Charmelyn from behind and holding her steady in the air.
As Charmelyn floated in their grasp, another figure appeared before her, descending gracefully.
Five gleaming swords hovered in a perfect orbit around the newcomer.
The woman with wavy blonde hair turned her head.
"Hi, I saved you... so this means I'm better than you, doesn't it?" she said, chuckling softly.
The person holding Charmelyn sighed heavily.
"Grill, this isn't the time for rivalry."
Still shaken from her near fall, Charmelyn stammered, "SexyGrill, Sexy-" "No!" the short-haired blonde interrupted, cutting her off.
"Just Bloom.
Only Bloom, okay?"
"Yes, sorry.
Thanks, Grill, Bloom," Charmelyn muttered quickly.
SexyGrill took the lead.
"Now, let me and Bloom handle the aerial battle.
You and the others focus on their summons on the ground."
"Okay, got it," Charmelyn replied.
As SexyBloom released her, she landed smoothly on the battlefield, immediately preparing to rejoin the fight below.

Turning toward Bloom, SexyGrill added with a mischievous chuckle, "We only have a little time, so let's take this demon out-and I'll be sure to take all the credit in front of Broken." "Save your confidence for after we've actually won," Bloom retorted.

chapters.title: Chapter 675: Shadowborn Aeriarchs
paragraphs: Western Gate. Optimus, Trison, Toberry, Ivana, and Fokil vs King Balam.

"Tora!!!" Max shouted loudly. "I'm seriously starting to lose it watching all of this. We're barely holding our ground against attacks from every direction, and now another wave of reinforcements has shown up... Tora, please, explain who all these people are. I recognize some of them as members of the Vensalor Guild, but the others..."
Tora gave an awkward grin, rubbing the back of his neck before replying. "Alright, Max, let's start with the Western Gate. That one over there? He's a blacksmith from Deadbay City."
"A blacksmith? How? From Deadbay City? Why didn't anyone notice him during the last war there?"
"Well," Tora said with a shrug, "I'm pretty sure the cameras didn't cover the entire fight, but I'm certain he was part of it."
"But how does a dwarf blacksmith suddenly end up here? Can you tell me more about him, Tora?"

Tora hesitated before answering, "I'm not sure I can explain all that, Max. I don't know much about him myself. But judging from the damage he's already dealt, I'm confident this guy is going to put up a strong fight against King Balam."
"Agreed, Tora. Now let's move on to the Eastern Gate."
Eastern Gate. Goldrich, Jovina, Melliandra, and Fang vs Countess Murmur.
"Am I seeing this right? Isn't that the Fae Beast you all fought during the expedition to the Fae Land? You were on that expedition, weren't you, Tora?"
"Yeah, Max, that's Fang," Tora confirmed, nodding. "But don't worry-he's on our side now. Fang is one of Jovina's summoned beasts."
"How...? I've noticed some Fae are now in Slumdon Town too. Is this also because of Broken?"
"Yes, I'd say so," Tora replied with a nod. "The Fae Beast now follows Broken and the Vensalor Guild, and it formed a contract with Jovina since she's the only Beast Master on the team."
"That's incredible, Tora," Max said. "It looks like the Vensalor Guild's ranks just got a whole lot stronger."

Southern Gate. Livelywood, Starfall, Elincia, and Wrath Champion Booba vs Duke Alloces. Max continued, "Alright, I noticed the Southern Gate has received some seriously strong reinforcements too. I clearly heard that man shouting something about being a Wrath Champion? Isn't he also a member of Vensalor, Tora?"
Tora chuckled nervously. "Yes, hehe, that's Booba. He's actually Elincia's brother."
"Oh, now that's an interesting piece of news," Max said, raising an eyebrow. "So, the Vensalor Guild officially has a Divine Champion, and it turns out he's Elincia's brother. Fascinating..."
Max leaned closer to the camera, a sly grin spreading across his face. "Well, I wouldn't be surprised if they've got more than one Divine Champion in their ranks."

Northern Gate. Charmelyn, Skywarden, Kingsley, SexyGrill and SexyBloom vs Marquis Orias. "And next, Tora, this is really interesting," Max said, leaning forward with a curious expression. "I know SexyGrill is a Lust Champion and also a Unique-grade class holder. But the girl with her-SexyBloom-I'm pretty sure they both supported Broken during the final battle. And they seem to have a close connection with him."

Max's face lit up with intrigue as he turned to Tora. "Now, tell me, because this has been a burning question for a lot of people. What exactly is the relationship between SexyGrill, SexyBloom, and Broken? I mean, they rarely come to the South Continent, yet they seem really close to him."
Tora grinned awkwardly at the question. "Max, I feel like you're exploiting me with all these questions."
"Oh, come on, Tora," Max replied with a laugh. "We all know how hard it is to get an interview with Broken, so as the representative of the Vensalor Guild, it's your job to answer this!"
Tora sighed, raising his hands. "Well, Max, I think there are some things I'll have to pass on for now. Let's just say the right time to address this question hasn't come yet."

"Oh, hahaha!" Max laughed, turning back to face the camera with a mischievous smile. "So, everyone, I know these two girls have definitely caught your attention, okay? But a word of warning-Broken, the leader of the Vensalor Guild, is standing right behind them. And trust me he's watching you.
Max finished with a small laugh, leaving her audience both entertained and curious.
Golden Age Company.
Marco sat with his legs crossed, tapping the armrest of his chair repeatedly with his fingers.
"What are the odds of victory against the Named Demons?"
"Sir, after the arrival of the new reinforcements, their chances of winning have increased by 18%. It's now at 37%," his assistant reported.
Marco sighed, clenching his fist in frustration. "Still below 50%."

They continued to watch the battle unfold on the large monitor. The screen showed that while the team had managed to hold their ground against the Named Demons, only those in this room knew the full weight of what would come next.
The assistant continued, "At the Western Gate, they're still lacking magic damage and defense penetration to bring down King Balam, whose tanker build is making him nearly invulnerable."
Marco nodded. "And their magic users are stationed at other gates."
"Exactly, sir," the assistant replied. "As for the Eastern Gate, the balance is better, but they need to force Countess Murmur to stay grounded longer if they want to deal more substantial
damage."
The assistant paused before adding, "And then there's Booba, the Wrath Champion."
Marco raised an eyebrow.

"He managed to gain his Divine Champion status by using his wealth to corner the original owner of the title," the assistant explained. "In the end, he successfully convinced the original owner to sell the Divine Champion status to him."
Marco gave a faint smile. "While his methods are certainly more humane, I can't deny that Booba's approach was clever."
"Yes," the assistant continued. "Afterward, Booba killed that player repeatedly over the course of a month until the blessing fully detached from them and transferred to him."
Marco's smile turned cold. "A move like that is surely an insult to the gods of sin."

"And at the Northern Gate," the assistant continued, "SexyGrill and SexyBloom should be able to hold their ground against Marquis Orias for now. However, Grill can only activate his blessing for a limited time, and she already used it to fly there using Bloom's skill."
"So, they won't last much longer," Marco noted.
"Yes, sir," the assistant confirmed.
"What about the Prince?" Marco asked.
A heavy silence followed his question. The others exchanged uneasy glances before their attention shifted to a separate monitor.
On the screen was an image of a swirling portal, suspended high in the sky, far above the battlefield. Its edges shimmered with unstable energy, rotating rapidly.
"Based on our calculations, sir," the assistant finally said, "the portal will fully open in approximately... ten minutes.
The tension in the room thickened as everyone fixed their eyes on the screen. The battle raged on in the other feeds, but their focus remained locked on the swirling gateway above.

When the predicted time arrived, the portal's rotation intensified, spinning faster and faster until, with a deafening silence, something burst forth from its center. A shadowy figure shot downward, wings beating furiously as it dove straight toward the ground.

The creature moved quickly, cloaked in shadow, its shape barely visible as it shot through the air. Instead of heading toward the battlefield, it suddenly changed direction, diving straight into the heart of the city's inner districts.
It landed in a crowded open square where terrified citizens were desperately trying to flee.

The impact of its landing was explosive. Dust and debris blasted outward, and the force of the shockwave brought a sudden, heavy silence to the panicked crowd. Slowly, the figure straightened, towering over everyone around it.

As the dust cleared, the being's full form was revealed. A man clad in jagged black and crimson armor. His massive wings, their sleek black feathers dissolving into shadow at the edges. Atop his head rested a twisted black crown adorned with glowing red gems. In his hand, he wielded a unique crimson staff.
The man's pale face came into view, his glowing crimson eyes cold and piercing beneath his dark, slicked-back hair. A faint smile played on his lips as he surveyed the chaos around him.
"Are the people of Yunatea this weak?"
Then, text appeared on the screen, identifying the newcomer:
[Prince Stolas - Shadowborn Aeriarchs Lv. 386]
[Named Demon - Ranking 36]
Okay, let's recap:
Western Gate: King Balam tanking hits like he's on vacation.
Eastern Gate: Countess Murmur flying circles around everyone like it's an airshow.
Southern Gate: Booba being a Wrath Champion and living rent-free in his enemies' heads.
Northern Gate: SexyGrill and SexyBloom. Enough said.
AND THEN PRINCE STOLAS SHOWED UP. I mean, nothing says "plot escalation" like a literal shadowy overlord diving into the fray.
Which gate would YOU want to defend? Drop your picks below and let's debate who's carrying the team right now! (Also, feel free to cheer for your faves because the next chapter is about to
go absolutely bananas.) []
